plans.title: First Steps
plans.subtitle: Meet Jesus in the book of Mark
plans.about: Start here. How to walk through a chapter, then the shortest and fastest Gospel, one chapter at a time.

plans.title: The Big Picture
plans.subtitle: The whole Bible in 30 chapters
plans.about: From the first chapter of Genesis to the last chapters of Revelation: the one story every book belongs to.

plans.title: Luke
plans.subtitle: Good Tidings of Great Joy
plans.about: The whole Gospel of Luke, chapter by chapter: an orderly account of Jesus, from the angel’s good tidings to the road to Emmaus.

plans.title: Acts
plans.subtitle: Ye Shall Be Witnesses unto Me
plans.about: The Acts of the Apostles, chapter by chapter: Luke’s second book, from the coming of the Holy Ghost in Jerusalem to Paul preaching in Rome.

plans.title: Genesis
plans.subtitle: In the Beginning
plans.about: The book of beginnings, chapter by chapter: creation, the fall and the flood, and God’s promise carried through Abraham, Isaac, Jacob and Joseph.

plans.title: Exodus
plans.subtitle: Let My People Go
plans.about: The great rescue, chapter by chapter: Moses and the burning bush, the plagues and the Passover, the Red Sea, and the commandments at Mount Sinai. Chapters 1 to 20.

plans.title: John
plans.subtitle: That Ye Might Believe
plans.about: The Gospel of John, chapter by chapter: the Word made flesh, seven signs, the great I AM sayings, the cross, and the empty tomb.

plans.title: Ruth
plans.subtitle: Whither Thou Goest
plans.about: A whole book in four chapters: Naomi’s loss, Ruth’s loyalty, the kindness of Boaz, and a redeemer in Bethlehem. A short win, finished in a week.

plans.title: Jonah
plans.subtitle: Salvation Is of the LORD
plans.about: A whole book in four chapters: the prophet who ran from God, the storm and the great fish, a city that turned back, and the God who is slow to anger.

plans.title: Esther
plans.subtitle: For Such a Time as This
plans.about: A whole book in ten chapters: an orphan who becomes queen, a plot to destroy her people, and a God who is never named, yet is at work in every turn.

plans.title: Daniel
plans.subtitle: Our God Whom We Serve Is Able
plans.about: The stories of Daniel, chapters 1 to 6: faithful young men in Babylon, a king’s dream, the fiery furnace, the writing on the wall, and the lions’ den.

plans.title: Joshua
plans.subtitle: Be Strong and of a Good Courage
plans.about: Israel crosses the Jordan into the land God promised: Rahab and the scarlet line, the walls of Jericho, the sun standing still, the land shared out by lot, and Joshua’s last call to choose whom we will serve.

plans.title: Judges
plans.subtitle: The LORD Raised Up Judges
plans.about: Israel forgets God again and again, and again and again he raises up a deliverer: Deborah, Gideon, Samson and more. An honest book about a dark time, told gently, that leaves us longing for a true King.

plans.title: 1 Samuel
plans.subtitle: The LORD Looketh on the Heart
plans.about: Hannah’s prayer, the boy Samuel who heard God’s voice, a nation that asked for a king, Saul’s rise and fall, and a shepherd boy named David, chosen by God and tested on the run.

plans.title: 2 Samuel
plans.subtitle: A Man After God’s Own Heart
plans.about: David becomes king, brings the ark to Jerusalem and receives God’s promise of a throne for ever. Then comes his great sin, his true repentance, and the sorrows that follow in his family, and God’s mercy through it all.

plans.title: James
plans.subtitle: Be Ye Doers of the Word
plans.about: A short, practical letter from James, the Lord’s brother: joy in trials, wisdom from God, faith that shows itself in what we do, taming the tongue, drawing near to God, and patient, earnest prayer.

plans.title: Philippians
plans.subtitle: Rejoice in the Lord Alway
plans.about: Paul’s letter of joy, written in chains to the church that began with Lydia and a jailer: to live is Christ, the mind of Christ who became a servant, pressing toward the mark, and the peace of God that passeth all understanding.

plans.title: 1 Kings
plans.subtitle: A Wise and an Understanding Heart
plans.about: Solomon asks God for wisdom and builds the temple of the LORD. Then his heart turns away, the kingdom is torn in two, and the prophet Elijah stands alone against Ahab, Jezebel and the prophets of Baal.

plans.title: 1 John
plans.subtitle: Beloved, Let Us Love One Another
plans.about: A warm, simple letter from an eyewitness of Jesus to his little children: God is light, so walk in the light; God is love, so love one another; and believe on the Son of God, that ye may know that ye have eternal life.

plans.title: 2 Kings
plans.subtitle: They That Be with Us Are More
plans.about: Elijah is taken up in a chariot of fire, and Elisha brings God’s mercy to widows, children and even a Syrian general. Then Israel falls to Assyria, good kings Hezekiah and Josiah turn Judah back to God, and at last Jerusalem falls to Babylon.

plans.title: Ezra
plans.subtitle: The Good Hand of Our God
plans.about: God stirs the heart of Cyrus, and the exiles come home to rebuild the house of the LORD. Through opposition and delay the temple is finished with joy, and Ezra the scribe teaches the people to seek God’s Word, and to do it.

plans.title: Nehemiah
plans.subtitle: Let Us Rise Up and Build
plans.about: A king’s cupbearer weeps for Jerusalem’s broken walls, prays, and goes home to rebuild them. Through mockery, threats and hardship the wall is finished in fifty two days, and the people gather to hear God’s Word and renew their covenant.

plans.title: Haggai
plans.subtitle: I Am with You, Saith the LORD
plans.about: Four short messages from the prophet Haggai to the people home from Babylon: consider your ways, and build the house of the LORD. When the work feels small, God says be strong, and work, for I am with you, and promises that the glory of this latter house shall be greater than of the former.

plans.title: Matthew
plans.subtitle: The Kingdom of Heaven Is at Hand
plans.about: The whole Gospel of Matthew, chapter by chapter: Jesus the promised King, the son of David, in whom the prophets are fulfilled. The Sermon on the Mount, the parables of the kingdom, the cross and the empty tomb, from Emmanuel, God with us, to lo, I am with you alway.

plans.title: Proverbs
plans.subtitle: The Fear of the LORD Is the Beginning of Wisdom
plans.about: One chapter a day of wise words from Solomon and others: a father’s counsel to his son, Wisdom calling in the streets, and hundreds of short sayings about words, work, money, friends and family, ending with the virtuous woman.

plans.title: Ephesians
plans.subtitle: Rooted and Grounded in Love
plans.about: Paul’s letter about who we are in Christ: chosen, saved by grace, made one family, filled with God’s love, walking in love and light at home and at work, and standing strong in the whole armour of God.

plans.title: Colossians
plans.subtitle: Christ Is All, and in All
plans.about: Paul’s letter about how great Jesus is: the image of the invisible God, who made all things and holds them together. In him we are complete, our sins are nailed to his cross, and our lives are hid with Christ in God.

plans.title: Philemon
plans.subtitle: Not Now as a Servant, but a Brother Beloved
plans.about: Paul’s shortest letter: a runaway servant named Onesimus has found Christ, and Paul sends him home to his master, asking him to welcome him back as a brother. A one-chapter story of forgiveness and new beginnings.

plans.title: Psalms
plans.subtitle: Let Every Thing That Hath Breath Praise the LORD
plans.about: Thirty favourite psalms, arranged by theme: the two ways and God’s Word, God the Creator, trusting God our shepherd and refuge, the God who knows us, songs for sorrow, repentance and forgiveness, and praise. Israel’s song book teaches us to bring every feeling to God.

plans.title: Exodus 21–40
plans.subtitle: Let Them Make Me a Sanctuary
plans.about: The second half of Exodus: laws for daily life, the covenant sealed at Sinai, the tabernacle where God would dwell among his people, the golden calf, and the glory of the LORD filling the tabernacle. Chapters 21 to 40.

plans.title: Numbers
plans.subtitle: The LORD Bless Thee, and Keep Thee
plans.about: Israel follows the cloud through the wilderness: the twelve spies, the years of wandering, water from the rock, the bronze serpent, Balaam and his donkey, and a new generation on the edge of the promised land.

plans.title: Deuteronomy
plans.subtitle: Hear, O Israel
plans.about: Moses speaks to a new generation on the edge of the promised land: the Ten Commandments, “Hear, O Israel”, the words Jesus quoted in the wilderness, the call to choose life, and Moses’ last look at the land.

1john-00.title: Meet the First Letter of John
1john-00.label: Meet 1 John
1john-00.question: John wrote so that his readers could know they have eternal life. Is there anything that makes you unsure about your relationship with God?

1john-01.title: God Is Light
1john-01.label: 1 John 1
1john-01.question: John says, if we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us. What makes it hard to be honest with God about our sin, and what does this verse promise?

1john-02.title: An Advocate with the Father
1john-02.label: 1 John 2
1john-02.question: John says the world passes away, but whoever does the will of God abides for ever. What is one thing you spend time on that will last, and one thing that will not?

1john-03.title: What Manner of Love
1john-03.label: 1 John 3
1john-03.question: John says, behold, what manner of love the Father hath bestowed upon us. How does it change the way you see yourself, to know that God calls you his child?

1john-04.title: God Is Love
1john-04.label: 1 John 4
1john-04.question: John says, we love him, because he first loved us. How does knowing that God loved you first change the way you love him, and the way you love others?

1john-05.title: This Is the Victory
1john-05.label: 1 John 5
1john-05.question: John says, he that hath the Son hath life. What would you say to a friend who asked you how they could know they have eternal life?

1kings-00.title: Meet the First Book of Kings
1kings-00.label: Meet 1 Kings
1kings-00.question: Solomon asked God for a wise and understanding heart. If God said to you, ask what I shall give thee, what would you ask for, and why?

1kings-01.title: God Save King Solomon
1kings-01.label: 1 Kings 1
1kings-01.question: Adonijah decided for himself, I will be king. Where are you tempted to push your own plans, instead of waiting for God’s?

1kings-02.title: Be Thou Strong Therefore
1kings-02.label: 1 Kings 2
1kings-02.question: David’s last words to Solomon were, be strong, and walk in God’s ways. If you could leave one charge to someone you love, what would it be?

1kings-03.title: An Understanding Heart
1kings-03.label: 1 Kings 3
1kings-03.question: Solomon said, I am but a little child: I know not how to go out or come in. Where do you feel too small for what is in front of you, and how could you ask God for help?

1kings-04.title: Wisdom and Understanding Exceeding Much
1kings-04.label: 1 Kings 4
1kings-04.question: Solomon’s wisdom showed itself in peace, in fairness, and in wonder at God’s world. Which of these would you most like God to grow in you, and why?

1kings-05.title: I Purpose to Build an House
1kings-05.label: 1 Kings 5
1kings-05.question: Solomon said, the LORD my God hath given me rest on every side, so I purpose to build. What good thing could you build for God with the peace and the gifts he has given you?

1kings-06.title: Neither Hammer nor Axe
1kings-06.label: 1 Kings 6
1kings-06.question: God told Solomon that walking in his ways mattered more than the beautiful building. What matters more to you, how things look on the outside, or what is happening in your heart?

1kings-07.title: Jachin and Boaz
1kings-07.label: 1 Kings 7
1kings-07.question: The pillars said, he shall establish, and in him is strength. Where do you need to remember today that your strength comes from God?

1kings-08.title: There Is No God Like Thee
1kings-08.label: 1 Kings 8
1kings-08.question: Solomon prayed for his own people, for strangers from far away, and for those who would one day be far from home. Who could you pray for today, that you do not usually remember?

1kings-09.title: Mine Eyes and Mine Heart Shall Be There
1kings-09.label: 1 Kings 9
1kings-09.question: God told Solomon that his eyes and his heart would be on his house always. How does it change your day to know that God’s eyes and heart are turned towards you?

1kings-10.title: The Half Was Not Told Me
1kings-10.label: 1 Kings 10
1kings-10.question: The queen of Sheba said, the half was not told me. In what ways have you found that God is greater and better than you first thought?

1kings-11.title: His Heart Was Not Perfect
1kings-11.label: 1 Kings 11
1kings-11.question: Solomon’s heart turned away slowly, when he was old. What can you do to guard your heart, so that you stay close to God all your life?

1kings-12.title: To Your Tents, O Israel
1kings-12.label: 1 Kings 12
1kings-12.question: Rehoboam listened to the advice he wanted to hear, instead of the advice that was wise. Whose advice do you listen to, and how can you tell when it is wise?

1kings-13.title: The Man of God out of Judah
1kings-13.label: 1 Kings 13
1kings-13.question: The man of God knew what God had told him, but he believed someone who claimed to have a newer message. How can you stay faithful to God’s Word when other voices tell you something different?

1kings-14.title: Thou Hast Cast Me Behind Thy Back
1kings-14.label: 1 Kings 14
1kings-14.question: Jeroboam’s wife tried to hide who she was, but God knew her before she spoke. How does it feel to know that God sees you as you really are, and still invites you to come to him?

1kings-15.title: Asa Did That Which Was Right
1kings-15.label: 1 Kings 15
1kings-15.question: Asa removed the idols, even when it meant standing against his own family. What would it look like for you to put God first, even when it is hard?

1kings-16.title: Ahab Did Evil Above All
1kings-16.label: 1 Kings 16
1kings-16.question: Omri built a great city, but the Bible says he did evil in God’s eyes. When you think about your own life, what do you think matters most to God?

1kings-17.title: The Barrel of Meal Shall Not Waste
1kings-17.label: 1 Kings 17
1kings-17.question: God fed Elijah through ravens, a brook, and a poor widow. How has God provided for you in ways you did not expect?

1kings-18.title: The God That Answereth by Fire
1kings-18.label: 1 Kings 18
1kings-18.question: Elijah asked, how long halt ye between two opinions? Where are you tempted to follow God halfway, and what would it look like to follow him fully?

1kings-19.title: A Still Small Voice
1kings-19.label: 1 Kings 19
1kings-19.question: Elijah thought he was the only faithful one left, but God had seven thousand. When have you felt alone in following God, and how does this story encourage you?

1kings-20.title: The LORD Is God of the Valleys
1kings-20.label: 1 Kings 20
1kings-20.question: The Syrians thought God was only God of the hills. Where in your life do you find it hardest to believe that God is with you?

1kings-21.title: The Inheritance of My Fathers
1kings-21.label: 1 Kings 21
1kings-21.question: Ahab got what he wanted, but sold himself to do evil. What things are you tempted to want so much that you might lose something more important?

1kings-22.title: What the LORD Saith unto Me
1kings-22.label: 1 Kings 22
1kings-22.question: Ahab hated Micaiah because he told the truth. How do you respond when someone tells you something true that you do not want to hear?

1samuel-00.title: Meet the First Book of Samuel
1samuel-00.label: Meet 1 Samuel
1samuel-00.question: God looks on the heart, not the outward appearance. What do you think God sees when he looks at your heart today?

1samuel-01.title: For This Child I Prayed
1samuel-01.label: 1 Samuel 1
1samuel-01.question: Hannah’s face was no longer sad, even before God answered her prayer. What do you think gave her that peace?

1samuel-02.title: Them That Honour Me I Will Honour
1samuel-02.label: 1 Samuel 2
1samuel-02.question: Samuel grew in favour with God, even though the priests around him were wicked. What helps a young person stay faithful when the people around them are not?

1samuel-03.title: Speak; for Thy Servant Heareth
1samuel-03.label: 1 Samuel 3
1samuel-03.question: Samuel did not recognise God’s voice at first, and needed Eli to help him. Who has helped you to hear God, and how could you help someone else?

1samuel-04.title: The Glory Is Departed from Israel
1samuel-04.label: 1 Samuel 4
1samuel-04.question: Israel trusted the ark to save them, instead of trusting God. What is the difference between trusting God, and trusting religious things?

1samuel-05.title: Dagon Was Fallen upon His Face
1samuel-05.label: 1 Samuel 5
1samuel-05.question: The Philistines thought they had captured the God of Israel, but he showed he was still in control. When has God seemed weak or absent to you, but later showed he was still at work?

1samuel-06.title: Who Is Able to Stand Before This Holy LORD God?
1samuel-06.label: 1 Samuel 6
1samuel-06.question: The men of Beth-shemesh asked, who is able to stand before this holy LORD God? How would you answer that question?

1samuel-07.title: Hitherto Hath the LORD Helped Us
1samuel-07.label: 1 Samuel 7
1samuel-07.question: Samuel looked back and said, hitherto hath the LORD helped us. Looking back over your own life, where can you see that God has helped you?

1samuel-08.title: Make Us a King Like All the Nations
1samuel-08.label: 1 Samuel 8
1samuel-08.question: Israel wanted a king so they could be like all the nations. Why do you think the desire to fit in is so strong, and how can we resist it when it pulls us away from God?

1samuel-09.title: Behold the Man Whom I Spake to Thee Of
1samuel-09.label: 1 Samuel 9
1samuel-09.question: Saul went looking for donkeys and found his calling instead. Has God ever led you somewhere unexpected through ordinary events?

1samuel-10.title: God Gave Him Another Heart
1samuel-10.label: 1 Samuel 10
1samuel-10.question: God gave Saul another heart, and filled him with his Spirit. What do you think it means for God to change someone from the inside?

1samuel-11.title: To Day the LORD Hath Wrought Salvation
1samuel-11.label: 1 Samuel 11
1samuel-11.question: Saul could have punished the men who mocked him, but he said, to day the LORD hath wrought salvation. Why do you think remembering God’s mercy helps us to be merciful?

1samuel-12.title: God Forbid That I Should Cease to Pray for You
1samuel-12.label: 1 Samuel 12
1samuel-12.question: Samuel said it would be a sin against the LORD to stop praying for the people. Who has God placed in your life to pray for faithfully?

1samuel-13.title: The LORD Hath Sought Him a Man After His Own Heart
1samuel-13.label: 1 Samuel 13
1samuel-13.question: Saul blamed the people, Samuel and the Philistines for his choice. Why do you think it is so easy to make excuses instead of admitting we were wrong?

1samuel-14.title: No Restraint to the LORD to Save by Many or by Few
1samuel-14.label: 1 Samuel 14
1samuel-14.question: Jonathan said, it may be that the LORD will work for us. What is the difference between being certain of the outcome, and being certain of God?

1samuel-15.title: To Obey Is Better Than Sacrifice
1samuel-15.label: 1 Samuel 15
1samuel-15.question: Saul said, I feared the people, and obeyed their voice. Whose opinion do you find it hardest to stand against, and how can you put God’s voice first?

1samuel-16.title: The LORD Looketh on the Heart
1samuel-16.label: 1 Samuel 16
1samuel-16.question: Man looketh on the outward appearance, but the LORD looketh on the heart. How does it change the way you see yourself, and others, to know that God looks on the heart?

1samuel-17.title: Five Smooth Stones out of the Brook
1samuel-17.label: 1 Samuel 17
1samuel-17.question: Everyone else saw a giant, but David saw a man defying the living God. How might seeing your problems in the light of who God is change the way you face them?

1samuel-18.title: The Soul of Jonathan Was Knit with the Soul of David
1samuel-18.label: 1 Samuel 18
1samuel-18.question: Jonathan loved David even though David might take his place as king, while Saul was consumed with jealousy. What do you think made the difference between them?

1samuel-19.title: Michal Let David Down Through a Window
1samuel-19.label: 1 Samuel 19
1samuel-19.question: When David was in danger, God protected him through Jonathan, through Michal, and through his Spirit. How have you seen God protect you, or others, through different people and ways?

1samuel-20.title: The LORD Be Between Me and Thee for Ever
1samuel-20.label: 1 Samuel 20
1samuel-20.question: Jonathan and David built their friendship on God. How does sharing faith in God make a friendship stronger?

1samuel-21.title: There Is None Like That; Give It Me
1samuel-21.label: 1 Samuel 21
1samuel-21.question: David went from facing Goliath with confidence to pretending to be mad out of fear. Why do you think even strong believers go through times of fear and weakness?

1samuel-22.title: With Me Thou Shalt Be in Safeguard
1samuel-22.label: 1 Samuel 22
1samuel-22.question: David took responsibility, saying, I have occasioned the death of all the persons of thy father’s house. Why is it important to admit our part when our choices hurt others?

1samuel-23.title: Jonathan Strengthened His Hand in God
1samuel-23.label: 1 Samuel 23
1samuel-23.question: Jonathan strengthened David’s hand in God by reminding him of God’s promises. Who has done that for you, and who could you do it for?

1samuel-24.title: Mine Hand Shall Not Be upon Thee
1samuel-24.label: 1 Samuel 24
1samuel-24.question: David’s men said, this is the day the LORD told you about. How can we tell the difference between an opportunity from God, and a temptation that only looks like one?

1samuel-25.title: Blessed Be Thy Advice
1samuel-25.label: 1 Samuel 25
1samuel-25.question: David was patient with Saul, but lost his temper with Nabal. Why do you think small insults can sometimes make us angrier than big trials?

1samuel-26.title: I Have Played the Fool
1samuel-26.label: 1 Samuel 26
1samuel-26.question: Saul said, I have played the fool, but he never really changed. What is the difference between being sorry for what we have done, and truly turning away from it?

1samuel-27.title: David Said in His Heart
1samuel-27.label: 1 Samuel 27
1samuel-27.question: David had seen God rescue him many times, yet he said, I shall now perish one day by the hand of Saul. Why do you think discouragement can make us forget what God has already done?

1samuel-28.title: The LORD Answered Him Not
1samuel-28.label: 1 Samuel 28
1samuel-28.question: Saul sought answers from a medium when God was silent. What are some ways people today look for guidance outside of God, and why can that be dangerous?

1samuel-29.title: Return, and Go in Peace
1samuel-29.label: 1 Samuel 29
1samuel-29.question: David got himself into a trap, and God got him out through people who did not even know God. Have you ever seen God rescue you from a situation you made for yourself?

1samuel-30.title: David Encouraged Himself in the LORD His God
1samuel-30.label: 1 Samuel 30
1samuel-30.question: David encouraged himself in the LORD when everyone else turned against him. What helps you to find strength in God when you feel alone?

1samuel-31.title: Saul Died, and His Three Sons
1samuel-31.label: 1 Samuel 31
1samuel-31.question: Saul began well, but ended badly, while the men of Jabesh-gilead remembered his kindness. What do you hope people will remember about you, and how can you live that way now?

2kings-00.title: Meet the Second Book of Kings
2kings-00.label: Meet 2 Kings
2kings-00.question: Second Kings shows a people who drifted from God, little by little, until it was too late. What helps you to stay close to God, so that you do not drift?

2kings-01.title: Is There Not a God in Israel?
2kings-01.label: 2 Kings 1
2kings-01.question: Ahaziah acted as though there were no God in Israel to ask. When do you find yourself turning to other things for help before turning to God?

2kings-02.title: A Double Portion of Thy Spirit
2kings-02.label: 2 Kings 2
2kings-02.question: Elisha asked, where is the LORD God of Elijah? When someone you depended on is no longer there, how can you find that God is still with you?

2kings-03.title: Make This Valley Full of Ditches
2kings-03.label: 2 Kings 3
2kings-03.question: The soldiers dug ditches before they saw any water. What would it look like for you to prepare in faith for something you are trusting God to do?

2kings-04.title: It Is Well
2kings-04.label: 2 Kings 4
2kings-04.question: The woman of Shunem said, it is well, even when her heart was breaking. What helps you to trust God when things go wrong?

2kings-05.title: Wash, and Be Clean
2kings-05.label: 2 Kings 5
2kings-05.question: Naaman almost missed his healing because the answer was too simple. Are there simple things God is asking you to do that you have been resisting?

2kings-06.title: Open His Eyes, That He May See
2kings-06.label: 2 Kings 6
2kings-06.question: Elisha’s servant could see the enemy, but not God’s army around them. What helps you to see God’s presence when you are afraid?

2kings-07.title: This Day Is a Day of Good Tidings
2kings-07.label: 2 Kings 7
2kings-07.question: The four lepers said, this day is a day of good tidings, and we hold our peace. Who could you share good news with this week?

2kings-08.title: The Man of God Wept
2kings-08.label: 2 Kings 8
2kings-08.question: Hazael said, is thy servant a dog, that he should do this? Why do you think people often cannot see what they are capable of, and how can we guard our hearts?

2kings-09.title: He Driveth Furiously
2kings-09.label: 2 Kings 9
2kings-09.question: God remembered the blood of Naboth, even years later. How does it help you to know that God sees every injustice, even when no one else does?

2kings-10.title: See My Zeal for the LORD
2kings-10.label: 2 Kings 10
2kings-10.question: Jehu said, come and see my zeal for the LORD, but his heart was not fully given to God. How can you tell the difference between serving God to be seen, and serving him from the heart?

2kings-11.title: Hid in the House of the LORD
2kings-11.label: 2 Kings 11
2kings-11.question: For years, the true king was hidden in the temple while a wicked queen ruled. When does it feel to you as if God’s plans are hidden, and how can you keep trusting him?

2kings-12.title: Jehoiada the Priest Instructed Him
2kings-12.label: 2 Kings 12
2kings-12.question: Joash did right as long as Jehoiada instructed him. What helps your faith to be your own, so that it stays strong even when others are not there to hold you up?

2kings-13.title: The Arrow of the LORD’S Deliverance
2kings-13.label: 2 Kings 13
2kings-13.question: The king struck the ground three times and stopped. In what area of your life might you be expecting too little from God?

2kings-14.title: Tarry at Home
2kings-14.label: 2 Kings 14
2kings-14.question: Amaziah’s victory over Edom made his heart proud, and it led to his defeat. How can you enjoy God’s blessings without letting them make you proud?

2kings-15.title: And So It Came to Pass
2kings-15.label: 2 Kings 15
2kings-15.question: In the year that king Uzziah died, Isaiah saw the Lord on his throne. When things around you feel unstable, how does it help to remember that God is still King?

2kings-16.title: I Am Thy Servant and Thy Son
2kings-16.label: 2 Kings 16
2kings-16.question: Ahaz refused God’s sign and turned to Assyria instead. Why do you think it can be easier to trust something we can see, than to trust God?

2kings-17.title: So Was Israel Carried Away
2kings-17.label: 2 Kings 17
2kings-17.question: The Samaritans feared the LORD, and served their own gods too. What other things compete with God for first place in people’s hearts today?

2kings-18.title: He Trusted in the LORD God of Israel
2kings-18.label: 2 Kings 18
2kings-18.question: The Rabshakeh asked, what confidence is this wherein thou trustest? How would you answer that question about your own life?

2kings-19.title: Thou Art the God, Even Thou Alone
2kings-19.label: 2 Kings 19
2kings-19.question: Hezekiah began his prayer with who God is, before he spoke about the problem. How might it change your prayers to start by remembering who God is?

2kings-20.title: I Have Seen Thy Tears
2kings-20.label: 2 Kings 20
2kings-20.question: Isaiah asked, what have they seen in thine house? If someone spent a day with you, what would they see about God in your life?

2kings-21.title: Both His Ears Shall Tingle
2kings-21.label: 2 Kings 21
2kings-21.question: Manasseh did more evil than any king of Judah, yet when he humbled himself, God heard him. What does that tell you about God’s mercy?

2kings-22.title: I Have Found the Book of the Law
2kings-22.label: 2 Kings 22
2kings-22.question: When Josiah heard God’s Word, he tore his clothes and humbled himself. How do you usually respond when God’s Word shows you something you need to change?

2kings-23.title: With All His Heart
2kings-23.label: 2 Kings 23
2kings-23.question: Josiah turned to the LORD with all his heart, soul and might. What would it look like for you to love God with everything you have?

2kings-24.title: At the Commandment of the LORD
2kings-24.label: 2 Kings 24
2kings-24.question: Again and again, the writer says, according to the word of the LORD. How does it help you to know that God is in control, even when things are going badly?

2kings-25.title: He Spake Kindly to Him
2kings-25.label: 2 Kings 25
2kings-25.question: Second Kings ends, not with the fire, but with a captive king lifted out of prison. Why do you think God wanted the book to end with that small sign of hope?

2samuel-00.title: Meet the Second Book of Samuel
2samuel-00.label: Meet 2 Samuel
2samuel-00.question: David was called a man after God’s own heart, and yet he sinned terribly. What do you think it means to have a heart after God’s heart?

2samuel-01.title: How Are the Mighty Fallen
2samuel-01.label: 2 Samuel 1
2samuel-01.question: David mourned for Saul instead of celebrating his death. What does it take to grieve for someone who has hurt us?

2samuel-02.title: Shall the Sword Devour for Ever?
2samuel-02.label: 2 Samuel 2
2samuel-02.question: Abner asked, shall the sword devour for ever? Why do you think conflicts between people who should be close, like family or friends, can be so hard to stop?

2samuel-03.title: A Prince and a Great Man Fallen This Day
2samuel-03.label: 2 Samuel 3
2samuel-03.question: Joab took revenge, and broke the peace David had made. Why do you think revenge so often makes things worse, instead of better?

2samuel-04.title: The LORD Hath Redeemed My Soul out of All Adversity
2samuel-04.label: 2 Samuel 4
2samuel-04.question: Mephibosheth seemed unimportant, but God had not forgotten him. Who in your community is easily forgotten, and how could you show them God’s care?

2samuel-05.title: The LORD God of Hosts Was with Him
2samuel-05.label: 2 Samuel 5
2samuel-05.question: David understood that God had made him king for his people’s sake. How might your life change if you saw every gift God has given you as being for the sake of others?

2samuel-06.title: David Danced Before the LORD with All His Might
2samuel-06.label: 2 Samuel 6
2samuel-06.question: David danced before the LORD with all his might, while Michal despised him. What holds you back from worshipping God wholeheartedly?

2samuel-07.title: I Took Thee from the Sheepcote
2samuel-07.label: 2 Samuel 7
2samuel-07.question: David wanted to build a house for God, but God said he would build a house for David. What does this teach us about how God’s grace works?

2samuel-08.title: David Executed Judgment and Justice unto All His People
2samuel-08.label: 2 Samuel 8
2samuel-08.question: David was a great warrior, but the writer says the most important thing was that he executed judgment and justice. Why do you think justice matters so much to God?

2samuel-09.title: Thou Shalt Eat Bread at My Table Continually
2samuel-09.label: 2 Samuel 9
2samuel-09.question: Mephibosheth called himself a dead dog, but David treated him like one of the king’s sons. How does it change you to know that God sees you as his child, not as you see yourself?

2samuel-10.title: Be of Good Courage, and Let Us Play the Men
2samuel-10.label: 2 Samuel 10
2samuel-10.question: Joab said, be of good courage, and the LORD do that which seemeth him good. What does it look like to do our best, and still leave the outcome to God?

2samuel-11.title: But the Thing That David Had Done Displeased the LORD
2samuel-11.label: 2 Samuel 11
2samuel-11.question: David went from one sin to another, trying to cover up the first. Why do you think trying to hide sin so often leads to even worse sin?

2samuel-12.title: Thou Art the Man
2samuel-12.label: 2 Samuel 12
2samuel-12.question: Both Saul and David sinned, but David said, I have sinned against the LORD, without excuses. Why do you think it is so hard to admit our sin without blaming others?

2samuel-13.title: And David Mourned for His Son Every Day
2samuel-13.label: 2 Samuel 13
2samuel-13.question: David was very angry, but did nothing, and it led to more sorrow. Why is it sometimes so hard to confront wrongdoing, especially in our own families?

2samuel-14.title: Yet Doth He Devise Means
2samuel-14.label: 2 Samuel 14
2samuel-14.question: The wise woman said that God devises means, that his banished be not expelled from him. How has God made a way to bring you close to him?

2samuel-15.title: So Absalom Stole the Hearts of the Men of Israel
2samuel-15.label: 2 Samuel 15
2samuel-15.question: Ittai said he would stay with David whether in death or life. What does it mean to follow Jesus with that kind of loyalty?

2samuel-16.title: It May Be That the LORD Will Look on Mine Affliction
2samuel-16.label: 2 Samuel 16
2samuel-16.question: David said of Shimei, let him alone, and let him curse. What do you think helped David to respond to insults without taking revenge?

2samuel-17.title: The LORD Had Appointed to Defeat the Counsel of Ahithophel
2samuel-17.label: 2 Samuel 17
2samuel-17.question: God defeated Ahithophel’s clever plan through Hushai. How does it encourage you to know that no plan can succeed against the LORD?

2samuel-18.title: O My Son Absalom
2samuel-18.label: 2 Samuel 18
2samuel-18.question: David said, would God I had died for thee. How does David’s grief help you understand God’s love for people who have turned away from him?

2samuel-19.title: Yea, Let Him Take All
2samuel-19.label: 2 Samuel 19
2samuel-19.question: Mephibosheth said, let him take all, because the king was home. What would it look like for you to love God more than anything he gives you?

2samuel-20.title: I Am One of Them That Are Peaceable and Faithful
2samuel-20.label: 2 Samuel 20
2samuel-20.question: The wise woman of Abel saved her city with a few wise words. When have you seen a calm, wise word stop a conflict from getting worse?

2samuel-21.title: Because of the LORD’s Oath
2samuel-21.label: 2 Samuel 21
2samuel-21.question: Saul broke his oath and it brought trouble, while David kept his oath to Jonathan. Why do you think God cares so much about the promises we make?

2samuel-22.title: The LORD Is My Rock, and My Fortress
2samuel-22.label: 2 Samuel 22
2samuel-22.question: David said, thy gentleness hath made me great. How has God’s gentleness, his patience and kindness, shaped your life?

2samuel-23.title: The Water of the Well of Bethlehem
2samuel-23.label: 2 Samuel 23
2samuel-23.question: David put his hope in God’s everlasting covenant, even though his own house had failed. Why is it so important that our hope rests on God’s promise, and not on our own goodness?

2samuel-24.title: Let Us Fall Now into the Hand of the LORD
2samuel-24.label: 2 Samuel 24
2samuel-24.question: David said he would not offer to God that which cost him nothing. What does it look like for your worship and service to God to cost you something?

acts-00.title: Meet the Book of Acts
acts-00.label: Meet Acts
acts-00.question: Jesus told his followers, ye shall be witnesses unto me. Who in your life might hear about Jesus from you as we walk through this book?

acts-01.title: Ye Shall Be Witnesses unto Me
acts-01.label: Acts 1
acts-01.question: Jesus said, ye shall be witnesses unto me. What is one thing you have seen Jesus do in your life that you could tell someone?

acts-02.title: Whosoever Shall Call on the Name of the Lord
acts-02.label: Acts 2
acts-02.question: The crowd asked, Men and brethren, what shall we do? What is God asking you to do in answer to Peter’s message today?

acts-03.title: Such as I Have Give I Thee
acts-03.label: Acts 3
acts-03.question: Peter said, such as I have give I thee. What do you have that you could give to someone in need today?

acts-04.title: Neither Is There Salvation in Any Other
acts-04.label: Acts 4
acts-04.question: The council took knowledge of them, that they had been with Jesus. What would help people see that you have been with Jesus today?

acts-05.title: We Ought to Obey God Rather than Men
acts-05.label: Acts 5
acts-05.question: The apostles said, we ought to obey God rather than men. Where do you need courage to put God first today?

acts-06.title: A Man Full of Faith and of the Holy Ghost
acts-06.label: Acts 6
acts-06.question: Stephen was a man full of faith and of the Holy Ghost, chosen to serve. What is one way God might be asking you to serve someone today?

acts-07.title: Lord Jesus, Receive My Spirit
acts-07.label: Acts 7
acts-07.question: Stephen prayed for the people who were stoning him. Who is one person you need to pray for, and forgive, today?

acts-08.title: They Went Every Where Preaching the Word
acts-08.label: Acts 8
acts-08.question: Philip asked, understandest thou what thou readest? Is there someone you could help to understand the Bible, or someone who could help you?

acts-09.title: He Is a Chosen Vessel unto Me
acts-09.label: Acts 9
acts-09.question: Jesus chose Saul, the enemy of the church, to carry his name. Who is someone you find hard to imagine following Jesus, that you could pray for today?

acts-10.title: God Is No Respecter of Persons
acts-10.label: Acts 10
acts-10.question: Peter said, God is no respecter of persons. Who is someone different from you that you could show God’s welcome to today?

acts-11.title: God Also to the Gentiles Granted Repentance unto Life
acts-11.label: Acts 11
acts-11.question: Barnabas encouraged the new believers to cleave unto the Lord with purpose of heart. What would it look like for you to hold on to Jesus on purpose today?

acts-12.title: But the Word of God Grew and Multiplied
acts-12.label: Acts 12
acts-12.question: The church prayed without ceasing for Peter. Who or what will you pray for earnestly today, and keep on praying for?

acts-13.title: I Have Set Thee to Be a Light of the Gentiles
acts-13.label: Acts 13
acts-13.question: Through Jesus is preached unto you the forgiveness of sins. Who in your life most needs to hear that message, and how could you share it?

acts-14.title: He Had Opened the Door of Faith unto the Gentiles
acts-14.label: Acts 14
acts-14.question: Paul said, we must through much tribulation enter into the kingdom of God. What hardship are you facing, and how can you keep trusting God through it today?

acts-15.title: Through the Grace of the Lord Jesus Christ We Shall Be Saved
acts-15.label: Acts 15
acts-15.question: Peter said, through the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ we shall be saved. What does it mean to you that you cannot earn God’s love, only receive it?

acts-16.title: Believe on the Lord Jesus Christ, and Thou Shalt Be Saved
acts-16.label: Acts 16
acts-16.question: The jailer asked, Sirs, what must I do to be saved? How would you answer that question in your own words?

acts-17.title: In Him We Live, and Move, and Have Our Being
acts-17.label: Acts 17
acts-17.question: The Bereans searched the scriptures daily, whether those things were so. How could you make searching the Scriptures a daily habit?

acts-18.title: Be Not Afraid, but Speak, and Hold Not Thy Peace
acts-18.label: Acts 18
acts-18.question: The Lord told Paul, be not afraid, but speak, for I am with thee. Where is God asking you to speak up for him?

acts-19.title: So Mightily Grew the Word of God and Prevailed
acts-19.label: Acts 19
acts-19.question: The believers at Ephesus burned their books of magic to follow Jesus. What is one thing God might be asking you to let go of today?

acts-20.title: That I Might Finish My Course with Joy
acts-20.label: Acts 20
acts-20.question: Paul wanted to finish his course with joy. What would it look like for you to run your race faithfully today?

acts-21.title: The Will of the Lord Be Done
acts-21.label: Acts 21
acts-21.question: Paul’s friends prayed, the will of the Lord be done. What situation in your life do you need to place in God’s hands with that prayer today?

acts-22.title: Thou Shalt Be His Witness unto All Men
acts-22.label: Acts 22
acts-22.question: Paul asked, What shall I do, Lord? What is the next step God is asking you to take today?

acts-23.title: Be of Good Cheer, Paul
acts-23.label: Acts 23
acts-23.question: The Lord stood by Paul and said, be of good cheer. Where do you most need to know that the Lord is standing beside you today?

acts-24.title: A Conscience Void of Offence
acts-24.label: Acts 24
acts-24.question: Felix said, when I have a convenient season, I will call for thee. What have you been putting off that God is asking you to deal with today?

acts-25.title: I Appeal unto Caesar
acts-25.label: Acts 25
acts-25.question: Festus said Paul affirmed that Jesus, who was dead, is alive. What difference does it make in your life today that Jesus is alive?

acts-26.title: I Was Not Disobedient unto the Heavenly Vision
acts-26.label: Acts 26
acts-26.question: Agrippa said, almost thou persuadest me to be a Christian. Is there any area of your life where you are almost, but not altogether, following Jesus?

acts-27.title: I Believe God, That It Shall Be Even as It Was Told Me
acts-27.label: Acts 27
acts-27.question: Paul said, I believe God, that it shall be even as it was told me. What promise of God will you hold on to in your storm today?

acts-28.title: With All Confidence, No Man Forbidding Him
acts-28.label: Acts 28
acts-28.question: Now that you have walked through the whole book of Acts, how will you carry the story on as Jesus’ witness, and who will you tell?

big-picture-00.title: The One Great Story
big-picture-00.label: The Big Picture
big-picture-00.question: Before we begin, where do you see yourself in God’s great story today?

bp-1kings-18.title: The LORD, He Is the God
bp-1kings-18.label: 1 Kings 18
bp-1kings-18.question: Elijah asked, how long halt ye between two opinions? What is competing with God for first place in your heart, that you will give up today?

bp-1samuel-17.title: The Battle Is the LORD’s
bp-1samuel-17.label: 1 Samuel 17
bp-1samuel-17.question: David remembered the lion and the bear before he faced the giant. What has God already done for you that will give you courage today?

bp-2kings-25.title: The City Was Broken Up
bp-2kings-25.label: 2 Kings 25
bp-2kings-25.question: Even after Jerusalem fell, God kept a light burning for David’s family. Where do you need to hold on to God’s faithfulness today?

bp-2samuel-07.title: Thy Throne Shall Be Established for Ever
bp-2samuel-07.label: 2 Samuel 7
bp-2samuel-07.question: David asked, who am I, that thou hast brought me hitherto? What has God brought you through, that you will thank him for today?

bp-acts-02.title: They Were All Filled with the Holy Ghost
bp-acts-02.label: Acts 2
bp-acts-02.question: The first believers continued in God’s Word, fellowship, breaking bread and prayer. Which of these will you give yourself to today?

bp-daniel-06.title: My God Hath Sent His Angel
bp-daniel-06.label: Daniel 6
bp-daniel-06.question: Daniel prayed three times a day, as he did aforetime. What daily habit of prayer will you keep, or begin, today?

bp-deuteronomy-06.title: Hear, O Israel
bp-deuteronomy-06.label: Deuteronomy 6
bp-deuteronomy-06.question: Moses said, talk of them when thou sittest in thine house, and when thou walkest by the way. In what ordinary moment will you speak of God today?

bp-exodus-03.title: I AM THAT I AM
bp-exodus-03.label: Exodus 3
bp-exodus-03.question: Moses asked, who am I? and God answered, I will be with thee. What task feels too big for you, that you will trust God to be with you in today?

bp-exodus-14.title: Stand Still, and See
bp-exodus-14.label: Exodus 14
bp-exodus-14.question: Moses said, fear ye not, stand still, and see the salvation of the LORD. What fear will you hand over to God today, and let him fight for you?

bp-exodus-20.title: I Am the LORD Thy God
bp-exodus-20.label: Exodus 20
bp-exodus-20.question: God said, I am the LORD thy God, which have brought thee out. Remembering what God has done for you, which commandment will you ask him to help you keep today?

bp-genesis-01.title: In the Beginning
bp-genesis-01.label: Genesis 1
bp-genesis-01.question: God made you in his own image. How will that change the way you see yourself, or someone else, today?

bp-genesis-03.title: Where Art Thou?
bp-genesis-03.label: Genesis 3
bp-genesis-03.question: God called, where art thou? Is there something you have been hiding from God that you will bring to him today?

bp-genesis-06.title: Noah Found Grace
bp-genesis-06.label: Genesis 6
bp-genesis-06.question: Noah did all that God commanded him, even before he saw any rain. What is one thing God has asked of you that you will do today, by faith?

bp-genesis-12.title: Get Thee Out of Thy Country
bp-genesis-12.label: Genesis 12
bp-genesis-12.question: Abram went out not knowing where he was going, only trusting the God who called him. What next step is God asking you to take today?

bp-genesis-22.title: God Will Provide Himself a Lamb
bp-genesis-22.label: Genesis 22
bp-genesis-22.question: Abraham trusted that God would provide, even when he could not see how. Where do you need to trust God to provide today?

bp-genesis-45.title: God Did Send Me Before You
bp-genesis-45.label: Genesis 45
bp-genesis-45.question: Joseph saw God’s hand even in the wrong done to him. Where in your own story do you need to trust that God means it for good?

bp-isaiah-53.title: Wounded for Our Transgressions
bp-isaiah-53.label: Isaiah 53
bp-isaiah-53.question: Isaiah says the LORD laid on him the iniquity of us all. What will you say to Jesus today, knowing that he carried your sins?

bp-jeremiah-31.title: A New Covenant
bp-jeremiah-31.label: Jeremiah 31
bp-jeremiah-31.question: God said, I have loved thee with an everlasting love. What would change today if you truly believed that God loves you like that?

bp-john-11.title: I Am the Resurrection, and the Life
bp-john-11.label: John 11
bp-john-11.question: Jesus asked Martha, believest thou this? How will you answer him today?

bp-joshua-06.title: The Wall Fell Down Flat
bp-joshua-06.label: Joshua 6
bp-joshua-06.question: God said, I have given, before the walls fell. What promise of God will you act on today, even before you see it?

bp-luke-02.title: Good Tidings of Great Joy
bp-luke-02.label: Luke 2
bp-luke-02.question: The angel said, unto you is born a Saviour. What does it mean to you today that Jesus came for you?

bp-luke-15.title: Was Lost, and Is Found
bp-luke-15.label: Luke 15
bp-luke-15.question: The father ran to his son while he was still a great way off. Which son are you most like today, and what will you do about it?

bp-luke-24.title: He Is Not Here, but Is Risen
bp-luke-24.label: Luke 24
bp-luke-24.question: The two disciples said, did not our heart burn within us? How has Jesus spoken to you through his Word on this walk?

bp-mark-15.title: Truly This Man Was the Son of God
bp-mark-15.label: Mark 15
bp-mark-15.question: Barabbas went free because Jesus took his place. What will you say to God today, knowing that Jesus took yours?

bp-matthew-05.title: Ye Are the Light of the World
bp-matthew-05.label: Matthew 5
bp-matthew-05.question: Jesus said, love your enemies and pray for them. Who is one person you find hard to love, that you will pray for today?

bp-nehemiah-02.title: Let Us Rise Up and Build
bp-nehemiah-02.label: Nehemiah 2
bp-nehemiah-02.question: Nehemiah prayed a quick prayer before he answered the king. In what moment today will you stop and pray before you speak or act?

bp-proverbs-03.title: Trust in the LORD with All Thine Heart
bp-proverbs-03.label: Proverbs 3
bp-proverbs-03.question: Proverbs says, in all thy ways acknowledge him. What part of your life will you bring to God and trust him with fully today?

bp-psalms-23.title: The LORD Is My Shepherd
bp-psalms-23.label: Psalm 23
bp-psalms-23.question: David said, the LORD is my shepherd. In what part of your life will you let him lead you today?

bp-revelation-21.title: Behold, I Make All Things New
bp-revelation-21.label: Revelation 21
bp-revelation-21.question: God says, behold, I make all things new. What would it mean for you to live today in the hope of that promise?

bp-ruth-01.title: Whither Thou Goest
bp-ruth-01.label: Ruth 1
bp-ruth-01.question: Ruth said, whither thou goest, I will go. Who is someone you will stand beside in faithful love today?

colossians-00.title: Meet the Letter to the Colossians
colossians-00.label: Meet Colossians
colossians-00.question: Paul wrote to show that Jesus is not just one part of life, but above everything. What would it look like for Jesus to be first in every part of your life?

colossians-01.title: The Image of the Invisible God
colossians-01.label: Colossians 1
colossians-01.question: Paul says Jesus is the image of the invisible God. What do you learn about what God is like, when you look at Jesus?

colossians-02.title: Rooted and Built Up in Him
colossians-02.label: Colossians 2
colossians-02.question: Paul says, as ye have received Christ Jesus the Lord, so walk ye in him. What helps your roots grow deeper in Jesus each day?

colossians-03.title: Seek Those Things Which Are Above
colossians-03.label: Colossians 3
colossians-03.question: Paul says, whatsoever ye do, do it heartily, as to the Lord. How would it change your everyday work to do it for Jesus?

colossians-04.title: Let Your Speech Be Alway with Grace
colossians-04.label: Colossians 4
colossians-04.question: Mark once let Paul down, but later Paul welcomed him back. What does Mark’s story teach you about failure, and about giving others a second chance?

daniel-00.title: Meet the Book of Daniel
daniel-00.label: Meet Daniel
daniel-00.question: Daniel stayed faithful to God in a world that did not know him. Where do you find it hardest to stay faithful to God in your everyday life?

daniel-01.title: Daniel Purposed in His Heart
daniel-01.label: Daniel 1
daniel-01.question: Daniel accepted a new name and a new language, but he drew a line at the king’s food. Where do you think you need to draw a line to stay faithful to God?

daniel-02.title: There Is a God in Heaven That Revealeth Secrets
daniel-02.label: Daniel 2
daniel-02.question: Daniel said, there is a God in heaven that revealeth secrets. What does it mean to you that God knows everything that is hidden, even in your own heart?

daniel-03.title: Our God Whom We Serve Is Able
daniel-03.label: Daniel 3
daniel-03.question: The three young men said, our God is able to deliver us, but if not, we will not bow. Is your trust in God strong enough to say, but if not? What would help it grow?

daniel-04.title: The Most High Ruleth in the Kingdom of Men
daniel-04.label: Daniel 4
daniel-04.question: Nebuchadnezzar said, is not this great Babylon, that I have built? What helps you to remember that everything good in your life is a gift from God?

daniel-05.title: Thou Art Weighed in the Balances
daniel-05.label: Daniel 5
daniel-05.question: Daniel told Belshazzar, the God in whose hand thy breath is, hast thou not glorified. How can you honour the God who holds your very breath in his hand?

daniel-06.title: Thy God Whom Thou Servest Continually
daniel-06.label: Daniel 6
daniel-06.question: We have walked through the stories of Daniel. Even King Darius said, thy God whom thou servest continually. What would it look like for you to serve God continually, in your everyday life?

ephesians-00.title: Meet the Letter to the Ephesians
ephesians-00.label: Meet Ephesians
ephesians-00.question: Ephesians first tells us who we are in Christ, and then how to live. How might knowing who you are in Christ change the way you live each day?

ephesians-01.title: Accepted in the Beloved
ephesians-01.label: Ephesians 1
ephesians-01.question: Paul says we are accepted in the beloved. How does it make you feel to know that, in Christ, God accepts you and welcomes you as his child?

ephesians-02.title: By Grace Are Ye Saved
ephesians-02.label: Ephesians 2
ephesians-02.question: Paul says, by grace are ye saved through faith; and that not of yourselves: it is the gift of God. Why do you think it is good news that we cannot earn our salvation?

ephesians-03.title: The Love of Christ, Which Passeth Knowledge
ephesians-03.label: Ephesians 3
ephesians-03.question: Paul prays that we would know how wide, long, deep and high is the love of Christ. Which of those four measurements of his love means the most to you right now, and why?

ephesians-04.title: Speaking the Truth in Love
ephesians-04.label: Ephesians 4
ephesians-04.question: Paul says to speak the truth in love. Why do you think truth and love need each other, and which one do you find harder?

ephesians-05.title: Walk as Children of Light
ephesians-05.label: Ephesians 5
ephesians-05.question: Paul says, ye were sometimes darkness, but now are ye light in the Lord. What difference does it make to know that God has changed who you are, not just what you do?

ephesians-06.title: The Whole Armour of God
ephesians-06.label: Ephesians 6
ephesians-06.question: Paul says we wrestle not against flesh and blood. How might it change the way you treat people who hurt you, to remember that they are not the real enemy?

esther-00.title: Meet the Book of Esther
esther-00.label: Meet Esther
esther-00.question: In the book of Esther, God is never named, yet he is at work in every turn of the story. Can you think of a time when God was at work in your life, even though you could not see him at the time?

esther-01.title: Vashti the Queen Refused to Come
esther-01.label: Esther 1
esther-01.question: God is not named in this chapter, but he was already preparing to protect his people. Where might God be quietly at work in your life right now, even though you cannot see it yet?

esther-02.title: The King Loved Esther
esther-02.label: Esther 2
esther-02.question: Esther did not plan to become queen, but step by step, she was placed where God would need her. Where has God placed you right now, and why might he have put you there?

esther-03.title: But Mordecai Bowed Not
esther-03.label: Esther 3
esther-03.question: Haman’s pride grew into hatred that wanted to destroy a whole people. How can we guard our hearts, so that small hurts and pride do not grow into bitterness?

esther-04.title: For Such a Time as This
esther-04.label: Esther 4
esther-04.question: Mordecai asked Esther, who knoweth whether thou art come to the kingdom for such a time as this? Where might God have placed you for such a time as this?

esther-05.title: The King Held Out the Golden Sceptre
esther-05.label: Esther 5
esther-05.question: Haman had so much, yet he said, all this availeth me nothing. What helps you to be content and thankful, instead of letting one thing spoil all your blessings?

esther-06.title: The Man Whom the King Delighteth to Honour
esther-06.label: Esther 6
esther-06.question: The king’s sleepless hours became the turning point of the whole story. What small thing has God used in your life to make a big difference?

esther-07.title: The Adversary and Enemy Is This Wicked Haman
esther-07.label: Esther 7
esther-07.question: Esther pleaded for her people before the king. What does it mean to you that Jesus ever lives to make intercession, to plead, for you?

esther-08.title: The Jews Had Light, and Gladness
esther-08.label: Esther 8
esther-08.question: Mordecai’s sackcloth was changed for royal robes, and the Jews had light, and gladness, and joy. How has God turned sorrow into joy in your life, or how are you hoping he will?

esther-09.title: Turned unto Them from Sorrow to Joy
esther-09.label: Esther 9
esther-09.question: Haman trusted in the lot, but the whole disposing thereof is of the LORD. What does it mean to you that your life is not in the hands of chance, but in the hands of God?

esther-10.title: Seeking the Wealth of His People
esther-10.label: Esther 10
esther-10.question: We have walked through the whole book of Esther. God was never named, yet his hand was in every turn. Where can you look back and see God’s hidden hand in your own story?

exodus-00.title: Meet the Book of Exodus
exodus-00.label: Meet Exodus
exodus-00.question: God heard the cry of his people in Egypt and came down to deliver them. What would you ask God to set you free from as we walk through this book?

exodus-01.title: The More They Afflicted Them, the More They Multiplied
exodus-01.label: Exodus 1
exodus-01.question: The midwives feared God more than they feared the king. Where do you need courage to do what is right, even when others want you to do wrong?

exodus-02.title: Because I Drew Him out of the Water
exodus-02.label: Exodus 2
exodus-02.question: God heard, remembered, looked upon and knew his people. Which of those four do you most need to remember today, and why?

exodus-03.title: I AM THAT I AM
exodus-03.label: Exodus 3
exodus-03.question: Moses asked, who am I? God answered, certainly I will be with thee. Where do you need to stop looking at your own weakness, and look at who God is?

exodus-04.title: I Will Be with Thy Mouth
exodus-04.label: Exodus 4
exodus-04.question: God asked Moses, what is that in thine hand? What ordinary gift or ability do you have that you could offer to God?

exodus-05.title: Who Is the LORD, That I Should Obey His Voice?
exodus-05.label: Exodus 5
exodus-05.question: Moses obeyed God, and things got worse. When has obeying God been hard, and how did you keep trusting him?

exodus-06.title: I Will Take You to Me for a People
exodus-06.label: Exodus 6
exodus-06.question: God said, I will take you to me for a people, and I will be to you a God. What does it mean to you that God wants you to belong to him?

exodus-07.title: The Egyptians Shall Know That I Am the LORD
exodus-07.label: Exodus 7
exodus-07.question: Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, and he would not listen. What helps keep your heart soft and open to God?

exodus-08.title: This Is the Finger of God
exodus-08.label: Exodus 8
exodus-08.question: Pharaoh kept bargaining, offering to obey only part way. Is there an area where you are offering God half-obedience instead of the whole?

exodus-09.title: That Thou Mayest Know That the Earth Is the LORD’S
exodus-09.label: Exodus 9
exodus-09.question: Some of Pharaoh’s servants feared the word of the LORD and acted on his warning. What would it look like for you to take God at his word this week?

exodus-10.title: All the Children of Israel Had Light in Their Dwellings
exodus-10.label: Exodus 10
exodus-10.question: Pharaoh kept trying to obey only part way. God said, there shall not an hoof be left behind. Is there anything you are holding back from God?

exodus-11.title: The LORD Doth Put a Difference
exodus-11.label: Exodus 11
exodus-11.question: Pharaoh refused God again and again, until his heart was hard. What helps you to say yes to God quickly, instead of putting him off?

exodus-12.title: When I See the Blood, I Will Pass over You
exodus-12.label: Exodus 12
exodus-12.question: God said, when I see the blood, I will pass over you. What does it mean to you that you are saved by what Jesus has done, not by what you have done?

exodus-13.title: The LORD Went Before Them
exodus-13.label: Exodus 13
exodus-13.question: God led Israel the long way, because he knew they were not ready for war. Where might God be leading you on a longer road for your own good?

exodus-14.title: Stand Still, and See the Salvation of the LORD
exodus-14.label: Exodus 14
exodus-14.question: Moses said, stand still, and see the salvation of the LORD. What situation do you need to stop panicking about, and trust God to handle?

exodus-15.title: The LORD Is My Strength and Song
exodus-15.label: Exodus 15
exodus-15.question: Israel sang God’s praise, and then three days later complained at Marah. How can you keep trusting God after the excitement of a blessing has passed?

exodus-16.title: Bread from Heaven
exodus-16.label: Exodus 16
exodus-16.question: God gave manna one day at a time, so his people had to trust him every day. What would it look like for you to trust God one day at a time?

exodus-17.title: Aaron and Hur Stayed Up His Hands
exodus-17.label: Exodus 17
exodus-17.question: Aaron and Hur held up Moses’ hands when he grew weary. Who holds up your hands, and whose hands could you hold up?

exodus-18.title: Thou Art Not Able to Perform It Thyself Alone
exodus-18.label: Exodus 18
exodus-18.question: Jethro told Moses, thou art not able to perform it thyself alone. What burden are you carrying that you need to share with others?

exodus-19.title: I Bare You on Eagles’ Wings
exodus-19.label: Exodus 19
exodus-19.question: God said, I bare you on eagles’ wings, and brought you unto myself. When have you felt God carrying you through a hard time?

exodus-20.title: Thou Shalt Have No Other Gods Before Me
exodus-20.label: Exodus 20
exodus-20.question: We have walked through the first twenty chapters of Exodus. God said, I am the LORD thy God, which have brought thee out. How has this walk helped you understand what God has done for you, and how you can live for him?

exodus-21.title: Now These Are the Judgments
exodus-21.label: Exodus 21
exodus-21.question: The law of an eye for an eye was given to limit revenge. Why do you think people often want to pay back more than the harm done to them, and what did Jesus teach instead?

exodus-22.title: For I Am Gracious
exodus-22.label: Exodus 22
exodus-22.question: God reminds Israel, ye were strangers in the land of Egypt, so do not mistreat strangers. How can remembering God’s kindness to us help us to be kind to others?

exodus-23.title: Thou Shalt Not Follow a Multitude to Do Evil
exodus-23.label: Exodus 23
exodus-23.question: God says, thou shalt not follow a multitude to do evil. Why is it so hard to stand apart from the crowd, and what could help you to do what is right?

exodus-24.title: Behold the Blood of the Covenant
exodus-24.label: Exodus 24
exodus-24.question: The elders saw God, and ate and drank in his presence, and God did not harm them. What does that tell you about the kind of relationship God wants with his people?

exodus-25.title: Let Them Make Me a Sanctuary
exodus-25.label: Exodus 25
exodus-25.question: God said, let them make me a sanctuary; that I may dwell among them. Why do you think God wants to live so close to his people?

exodus-26.title: The Vail Shall Divide
exodus-26.label: Exodus 26
exodus-26.question: From the outside, the tabernacle looked plain, but inside it was glorious. What do you think that teaches us about how God sees people, and about Jesus?

exodus-27.title: To Cause the Lamp to Burn Always
exodus-27.label: Exodus 27
exodus-27.question: The courtyard of the tabernacle had only one gate, but it was wide. What do you think that teaches us about the way to God?

exodus-28.title: Holiness to the LORD
exodus-28.label: Exodus 28
exodus-28.question: Aaron carried the names of all the tribes on his shoulders and on his heart. How does it make you feel to know that Jesus, our great high priest, carries your name before God?

exodus-29.title: I Will Dwell Among the Children of Israel
exodus-29.label: Exodus 29
exodus-29.question: Blood was put on the priests’ right ear, right thumb and right big toe. What might it look like for you to give your ears, your hands and your feet to God?

exodus-30.title: Sweet Incense Before the LORD
exodus-30.label: Exodus 30
exodus-30.question: In the half shekel offering, the rich gave no more and the poor gave no less. What does that teach us about how God sees every person?

exodus-31.title: Written with the Finger of God
exodus-31.label: Exodus 31
exodus-31.question: The first person in the Bible described as filled with the spirit of God was a craftsman. What does that tell you about the gifts God gives, and how he can use them?

exodus-32.title: Who Is on the LORD’S Side?
exodus-32.label: Exodus 32
exodus-32.question: Aaron said, I cast it into the fire, and there came out this calf. Why do you think people make excuses instead of owning up to what they have done?

exodus-33.title: Shew Me Thy Glory
exodus-33.label: Exodus 33
exodus-33.question: Moses said, if thy presence go not with me, carry us not up hence. Why do you think God’s presence mattered more to Moses than the promised land?

exodus-34.title: The LORD, Merciful and Gracious
exodus-34.label: Exodus 34
exodus-34.question: After the golden calf, God gave his people a second chance, and wrote the commandments again. What does that tell you about God, and how might it help you when you have failed?

exodus-35.title: Every One Whose Heart Stirred Him Up
exodus-35.label: Exodus 35
exodus-35.question: The same people who gave their gold for the golden calf now gave it for God’s house. What do you think changed their hearts?

exodus-36.title: Much More Than Enough
exodus-36.label: Exodus 36
exodus-36.question: Chapters thirty six to thirty nine repeat God’s instructions almost word for word, to show that the people did exactly what God said. Why do you think careful obedience matters to God?

exodus-37.title: Bezaleel Made the Ark
exodus-37.label: Exodus 37
exodus-37.question: Bezaleel never knew all the places the ark he made would go. How does it help you to know that God can use faithful work in ways we may never see?

exodus-38.title: Of the Lookingglasses of the Women
exodus-38.label: Exodus 38
exodus-38.question: The women gave up their mirrors so that the priests could wash before serving God. What do you think it means to look away from ourselves, and towards God and others?

exodus-39.title: As the LORD Commanded Moses
exodus-39.label: Exodus 39
exodus-39.question: The phrase as the LORD commanded Moses is repeated seven times in this chapter. Why do you think God wanted the Bible to show so clearly that the people obeyed him exactly?

exodus-40.title: The Glory of the LORD Filled the Tabernacle
exodus-40.label: Exodus 40
exodus-40.question: Exodus begins with God’s people as slaves building for Pharaoh, and ends with God’s glory filling the house they built for him. What does this whole story teach you about God?

ezra-00.title: Meet the Book of Ezra
ezra-00.label: Meet Ezra
ezra-00.question: The people of Ezra’s day came home to ruins, and began to rebuild. Is there anything in your life that God might want to help you rebuild?

ezra-01.title: The LORD Stirred Up the Spirit of Cyrus
ezra-01.label: Ezra 1
ezra-01.question: Cyrus asked, who is there among you, that will go up and build? If God asked you that question today, how would you answer?

ezra-02.title: Every One unto His City
ezra-02.label: Ezra 2
ezra-02.question: Every family and town was counted and named in Ezra’s list. How does it feel to know that God knows you by name?

ezra-03.title: A Great Shout
ezra-03.label: Ezra 3
ezra-03.question: Some people wept for what was lost, and some shouted for joy at what was beginning. Which are you more likely to do, and why?

ezra-04.title: They Weakened the Hands
ezra-04.label: Ezra 4
ezra-04.question: The enemies weakened the hands of the builders until the work stopped. What tends to discourage you from serving God, and how can you resist it?

ezra-05.title: The Eye of Their God Was upon the Elders
ezra-05.label: Ezra 5
ezra-05.question: The builders said, we are the servants of the God of heaven and earth. How would you describe who you are, if someone asked about your faith?

ezra-06.title: With Joy
ezra-06.label: Ezra 6
ezra-06.question: Enemies tried to stop the building, but in the end their taxes helped pay for it. When have you seen God turn something bad into something good?

ezra-07.title: Ezra Had Prepared His Heart
ezra-07.label: Ezra 7
ezra-07.question: Ezra prepared his heart to seek God’s Word, to do it, and to teach it. Which of those three do you find easiest, and which is hardest?

ezra-08.title: The Hand of Our God Is upon All Them for Good
ezra-08.label: Ezra 8
ezra-08.question: Ezra was ashamed to ask for soldiers, after telling the king that God protects those who seek him. How do your actions show what you really believe about God?

ezra-09.title: Less Than Our Iniquities Deserve
ezra-09.label: Ezra 9
ezra-09.question: Ezra confessed the people’s sin as if it were his own, saying our iniquities. Why do you think he did that, and what can we learn from it?

ezra-10.title: There Is Hope in Israel
ezra-10.label: Ezra 10
ezra-10.question: Shechaniah said, yet now there is hope in Israel. When you have failed, what helps you to remember that there is still hope with God?

genesis-00.title: Meet the Book of Genesis
genesis-00.label: Meet Genesis
genesis-00.question: Genesis is the book of beginnings. Where in your own life do you need God to make a new beginning?

genesis-01.title: And God Saw That It Was Good
genesis-01.label: Genesis 1
genesis-01.question: God made man and woman in his own image. How should knowing that change the way you see yourself, and the people around you?

genesis-02.title: The Breath of Life
genesis-02.label: Genesis 2
genesis-02.question: God said, it is not good that the man should be alone. Who has God put in your life, and who might need you to be a friend to them?

genesis-03.title: Where Art Thou?
genesis-03.label: Genesis 3
genesis-03.question: God called out to Adam, where art thou? If God asked you that question today, how would you answer him?

genesis-04.title: Am I My Brother’s Keeper?
genesis-04.label: Genesis 4
genesis-04.question: God warned Cain that sin was crouching at the door. What feelings do you need to bring to God before they grow into something worse?

genesis-05.title: Enoch Walked with God
genesis-05.label: Genesis 5
genesis-05.question: Enoch walked with God through ordinary family life, day after day. What would it look like for you to walk with God this week?

genesis-06.title: Noah Found Grace in the Eyes of the LORD
genesis-06.label: Genesis 6
genesis-06.question: Noah found grace in the eyes of the LORD, and then he obeyed all that God commanded him. Is there anything God has asked you to do that you have not yet done?

genesis-07.title: The LORD Shut Him In
genesis-07.label: Genesis 7
genesis-07.question: God shut Noah into the ark and kept him safe through the flood. What does it mean to you that God holds you safe in the storms of life?

genesis-08.title: God Remembered Noah
genesis-08.label: Genesis 8
genesis-08.question: God remembered Noah, and sent a dove with an olive leaf as a sign of hope. What signs of God’s faithfulness have you seen in your own life?

genesis-09.title: I Do Set My Bow in the Cloud
genesis-09.label: Genesis 9
genesis-09.question: God set his bow in the cloud as a sign that he would remember his promise. What promise of God do you need to remember today?

genesis-10.title: By These Were the Nations Divided
genesis-10.label: Genesis 10
genesis-10.question: Genesis ten shows that all nations come from one family. How should that change the way you think about people who are different from you?

genesis-11.title: Let Us Make Us a Name
genesis-11.label: Genesis 11
genesis-11.question: The builders of Babel wanted to make a name for themselves. Where are you tempted to make your own name great, instead of trusting God?

genesis-12.title: Get Thee Out of Thy Country
genesis-12.label: Genesis 12
genesis-12.question: God called Abram to leave what was familiar and follow him, not knowing where he was going. What might God be asking you to leave behind, or to step into, in faith?

genesis-13.title: Let There Be No Strife
genesis-13.label: Genesis 13
genesis-13.question: Abram let Lot choose first, trusting God to provide. Is there a situation where you need to let go of your rights for the sake of peace?

genesis-14.title: Blessed Be Abram of the Most High God
genesis-14.label: Genesis 14
genesis-14.question: Abram gave thanks to God for the victory, and refused the king of Sodom’s offer. Is there anything you need to turn down, so that God gets the glory in your life?

genesis-15.title: He Believed in the LORD
genesis-15.label: Genesis 15
genesis-15.question: Abram believed God, and God counted it to him for righteousness. What would it mean for you to trust God’s promise, rather than your own goodness, to make you right with him?

genesis-16.title: Thou God Seest Me
genesis-16.label: Genesis 16
genesis-16.question: Hagar called God, thou God seest me. What difference does it make to you today that God sees you and hears you?

genesis-17.title: I Am the Almighty God
genesis-17.label: Genesis 17
genesis-17.question: God revealed himself to Abraham as the Almighty God, when Abraham’s own strength had run out. Where do you need to trust God’s strength instead of your own?

genesis-18.title: Is Any Thing Too Hard for the LORD?
genesis-18.label: Genesis 18
genesis-18.question: God asked, is any thing too hard for the LORD? What would you bring to God in prayer if you truly believed that nothing is too hard for him?

genesis-19.title: Escape for Thy Life
genesis-19.label: Genesis 19
genesis-19.question: Lot lingered, and his wife looked back. Is there anything in your life that is pulling your heart back, when God is calling you forward?

genesis-20.title: Surely the Fear of God Is Not in This Place
genesis-20.label: Genesis 20
genesis-20.question: Abraham repeated an old mistake, but God stayed faithful and still used him to bless others. What old fear or habit do you need God to help you leave behind?

genesis-21.title: God Hath Made Me to Laugh
genesis-21.label: Genesis 21
genesis-21.question: Sarah said, God hath made me to laugh. When has God turned your sorrow or your doubt into joy?

genesis-22.title: God Will Provide
genesis-22.label: Genesis 22
genesis-22.question: Abraham told Isaac, God will provide himself a lamb. Where do you need to trust God to provide for you today?

genesis-23.title: I Am a Stranger and a Sojourner
genesis-23.label: Genesis 23
genesis-23.question: Abraham called himself a stranger and a sojourner, living by God’s promise. What helps you remember that this world is not your final home?

genesis-24.title: I Being in the Way, the LORD Led Me
genesis-24.label: Genesis 24
genesis-24.question: The servant said, I being in the way, the LORD led me. How have you seen God guide you as you walked in obedience to him?

genesis-25.title: Esau Despised His Birthright
genesis-25.label: Genesis 25
genesis-25.question: Esau traded his birthright for a bowl of stew. What is one thing you might be tempted to put ahead of what matters most to God?

genesis-26.title: The LORD Hath Made Room for Us
genesis-26.label: Genesis 26
genesis-26.question: Isaac kept moving and digging new wells until the LORD made room for him. Where do you need to trust God, instead of fighting for your own way?

genesis-27.title: The Voice Is Jacob’s Voice
genesis-27.label: Genesis 27
genesis-27.question: Jacob grabbed the blessing by deception instead of waiting for God. Where are you tempted to take a shortcut instead of trusting God’s timing?

genesis-28.title: Surely the LORD Is in This Place
genesis-28.label: Genesis 28
genesis-28.question: Jacob said, surely the LORD is in this place; and I knew it not. Where might God be present in your life right now, in a place you did not expect?

genesis-29.title: They Seemed unto Him but a Few Days
genesis-29.label: Genesis 29
genesis-29.question: Leah stopped seeking her husband’s love and said, now will I praise the LORD. Where do you need to find your worth in God instead of in other people?

genesis-30.title: God Remembered Rachel
genesis-30.label: Genesis 30
genesis-30.question: Rachel and Leah were caught up in jealousy and competition. Who are you tempted to compare yourself with, and how could you bring that to God?

genesis-31.title: The LORD Watch Between Me and Thee
genesis-31.label: Genesis 31
genesis-31.question: Jacob said, God hath seen mine affliction and the labour of my hands. Where do you need to trust that God sees what you are going through?

genesis-32.title: I Will Not Let Thee Go, Except Thou Bless Me
genesis-32.label: Genesis 32
genesis-32.question: Jacob said, I will not let thee go, except thou bless me. What is one thing you need to keep bringing to God in prayer, without letting go?

genesis-33.title: Esau Ran to Meet Him
genesis-33.label: Genesis 33
genesis-33.question: Esau ran to meet his brother and embraced him. Is there someone you need to forgive, or ask forgiveness from?

genesis-34.title: Which Thing Ought Not to Be Done
genesis-34.label: Genesis 34
genesis-34.question: Jacob stayed silent, and his sons took revenge. When you see something wrong, how can you respond in a way that is neither silent nor cruel?

genesis-35.title: Arise, Go Up to Bethel
genesis-35.label: Genesis 35
genesis-35.question: Jacob told his family to put away their strange gods before going to Bethel. What might God be asking you to put away, so that you can draw closer to him?

genesis-36.title: These Are the Generations of Esau
genesis-36.label: Genesis 36
genesis-36.question: Esau’s choices shaped the history of his whole family. What choices are you making now that might affect the people who come after you?

genesis-37.title: Behold, This Dreamer Cometh
genesis-37.label: Genesis 37
genesis-37.question: Joseph’s brothers tried to stop his dreams, but God used even their sin to fulfil his plan. Where do you need to trust that God is still at work in a painful situation?

genesis-38.title: She Hath Been More Righteous Than I
genesis-38.label: Genesis 38
genesis-38.question: Judah said, she hath been more righteous than I. Is there someone you need to admit you have treated unfairly?

genesis-39.title: The LORD Was with Joseph
genesis-39.label: Genesis 39
genesis-39.question: Joseph asked, how then can I do this great wickedness, and sin against God? What helps you to say no to temptation, even when no one else would know?

genesis-40.title: Do Not Interpretations Belong to God?
genesis-40.label: Genesis 40
genesis-40.question: Joseph helped the butler, but the butler forgot him. How do you keep trusting God when people forget you, or when his answer seems slow in coming?

genesis-41.title: God Shall Give Pharaoh an Answer of Peace
genesis-41.label: Genesis 41
genesis-41.question: Joseph named his son Ephraim, saying, God hath caused me to be fruitful in the land of my affliction. How has God made you fruitful in a hard place?

genesis-42.title: We Are Verily Guilty Concerning Our Brother
genesis-42.label: Genesis 42
