genesis-42.question: Jacob said, all these things are against me, but God was working everything for good. Where do you need to trust that God is working, even when it looks like everything is against you?

genesis-43.title: God Be Gracious unto Thee, My Son
genesis-43.label: Genesis 43
genesis-43.question: Judah said, I will be surety for him. Who is someone you could take responsibility for, protect, or stand beside this week?

genesis-44.title: How Shall I Go Up to My Father?
genesis-44.label: Genesis 44
genesis-44.question: Judah offered to take Benjamin’s place. How does his offer help you understand what Jesus has done for you?

genesis-45.title: I Am Joseph Your Brother
genesis-45.label: Genesis 45
genesis-45.question: Joseph said, it was not you that sent me hither, but God. How might seeing God at work in your story help you to forgive someone who has hurt you?

genesis-46.title: Fear Not to Go Down into Egypt
genesis-46.label: Genesis 46
genesis-46.question: God told Jacob, I will go down with thee into Egypt. Where do you need the promise that God will go with you?

genesis-47.title: The Days of the Years of My Pilgrimage
genesis-47.label: Genesis 47
genesis-47.question: Jacob called his life a pilgrimage. How does thinking of your life as a journey toward God change the way you face hard times?

genesis-48.title: The Angel Which Redeemed Me from All Evil
genesis-48.label: Genesis 48
genesis-48.question: Jacob called God the God which fed me all my life long. Looking back over your own life, where can you see God’s care?

genesis-49.title: Unto Him Shall the Gathering of the People Be
genesis-49.label: Genesis 49
genesis-49.question: Jacob prayed, I have waited for thy salvation, O LORD. What are you waiting for God to do, and how can you keep trusting him while you wait?

genesis-50.title: God Meant It unto Good
genesis-50.label: Genesis 50
genesis-50.question: We have walked through the whole book of Genesis. Joseph said, ye thought evil against me; but God meant it unto good. How has this book helped you trust that God is at work in your story?

haggai-00.title: Meet the Book of Haggai
haggai-00.label: Meet Haggai
haggai-00.question: Haggai’s people put their own houses first and left God’s house in ruins. What things in your life tend to crowd God out?

haggai-01.title: Consider Your Ways
haggai-01.label: Haggai 1
haggai-01.question: The people said, the time is not come, while they made their own houses beautiful. Is there something you keep putting off, that you know God wants you to do?

haggai-02.title: The Glory of This Latter House
haggai-02.label: Haggai 2
haggai-02.question: The old men thought the new temple was nothing compared to the old one. When have you felt that what you could do for God was too small to matter?

james-00.title: Meet the Book of James
james-00.label: Meet James
james-00.question: James says that hearing God’s Word without doing it is like looking in a mirror and forgetting what you saw. What is one thing you have heard from God’s Word that you want to start doing?

james-01.title: Count It All Joy
james-01.label: James 1
james-01.question: James says, count it all joy when trials come, because they make our faith stronger. How has God used a hard time in your life to help you grow?

james-02.title: Faith Without Works Is Dead
james-02.label: James 2
james-02.question: James says, show me thy faith by thy works. If someone watched your life this week, what would they see that shows you trust God?

james-03.title: The Wisdom That Is from Above
james-03.label: James 3
james-03.question: James says our words are like a rudder, a spark, and a spring of water. What would change in your home, your work or your friendships if your words were full of the wisdom from above?

james-04.title: Draw Nigh to God
james-04.label: James 4
james-04.question: James promises, draw nigh to God, and he will draw nigh to you. What is one way you can come closer to God this week?

james-05.title: The Effectual Fervent Prayer
james-05.label: James 5
james-05.question: James says that the earnest prayer of a righteous person achieves a great deal. Who will you pray for, faithfully, this week, and what will you ask God to do?

john-00.title: Meet the Book of John
john-00.label: Meet John
john-00.question: John wrote his Gospel so that people might believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God. As we walk through this book, what question about Jesus would you most like to see answered?

john-01.title: The Word Was Made Flesh
john-01.label: John 1
john-01.question: John says that to as many as received him, Jesus gave power to become the sons of God. What does it mean for you to receive Jesus?

john-02.title: Whatsoever He Saith unto You, Do It
john-02.label: John 2
john-02.question: Mary said, whatsoever he saith unto you, do it. What is one thing Jesus is asking you to do, that you need to obey even before you understand it?

john-03.title: For God So Loved the World
john-03.label: John 3
john-03.question: Jesus said, ye must be born again. What difference has God’s new life made in you, or what difference would you like it to make?

john-04.title: A Well of Water Springing Up into Everlasting Life
john-04.label: John 4
john-04.question: Jesus offered the woman living water, so that she would never thirst again. What are you thirsty for, and how could Jesus satisfy that thirst?

john-05.title: Wilt Thou Be Made Whole?
john-05.label: John 5
john-05.question: Jesus asked the man, wilt thou be made whole? If Jesus asked you that question today, what would you say?

john-06.title: I Am the Bread of Life
john-06.label: John 6
john-06.question: Peter said, Lord, to whom shall we go? thou hast the words of eternal life. When following Jesus feels hard, what keeps you from walking away?

john-07.title: If Any Man Thirst, Let Him Come unto Me
john-07.label: John 7
john-07.question: The officers said, never man spake like this man. What words of Jesus have most moved or changed you?

john-08.title: The Truth Shall Make You Free
john-08.label: John 8
john-08.question: Jesus said to the woman, neither do I condemn thee: go, and sin no more. How do you need to receive both his mercy and his call today?

john-09.title: Whereas I Was Blind, Now I See
john-09.label: John 9
john-09.question: The man said, one thing I know, that, whereas I was blind, now I see. What is one thing you know Jesus has done for you?

john-10.title: I Am the Good Shepherd
john-10.label: John 10
john-10.question: Jesus said, my sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me. How do you listen for the voice of your Shepherd?

john-11.title: Thou Shouldest See the Glory of God
john-11.label: John 11
john-11.question: Jesus asked Martha, believest thou this? What does it mean to you that Jesus is the resurrection and the life?

john-12.title: Sir, We Would See Jesus
john-12.label: John 12
john-12.question: Jesus said that a corn of wheat must fall into the ground and die to bear much fruit. What might God be asking you to let go of, so that your life can bear fruit?

john-13.title: Love One Another, As I Have Loved You
john-13.label: John 13
john-13.question: Jesus washed his disciples’ feet, even the feet of Judas. Who is Jesus asking you to serve or to love, even though it is hard?

john-14.title: I Am the Way, the Truth, and the Life
john-14.label: John 14
john-14.question: Jesus said, I am the way, the truth, and the life. What does it mean to you that Jesus is the way to the Father?

john-15.title: I Am the Vine, Ye Are the Branches
john-15.label: John 15
john-15.question: Jesus said, without me ye can do nothing. What would it look like for you to abide in Jesus, instead of trying to bear fruit in your own strength?

john-16.title: Be of Good Cheer; I Have Overcome the World
john-16.label: John 16
john-16.question: Jesus said, in the world ye shall have tribulation: but be of good cheer; I have overcome the world. How does knowing that Jesus has overcome help you face your troubles?

john-17.title: That They All May Be One
john-17.label: John 17
john-17.question: Jesus prayed that all who believe in him would be one. What could you do to help the believers around you live in unity and love?

john-18.title: My Kingdom Is Not of This World
john-18.label: John 18
john-18.question: Pilate asked, what is truth? Jesus said, every one that is of the truth heareth my voice. How do you listen for the voice of Jesus?

john-19.title: It Is Finished
john-19.label: John 19
john-19.question: Jesus said, it is finished. What does it mean to you that the work of your salvation has been paid in full?

john-20.title: That Ye Might Believe
john-20.label: John 20
john-20.question: Jesus said, blessed are they that have not seen, and yet have believed. What helps you to believe in Jesus, even though you have not seen him?

john-21.title: Lovest Thou Me? Feed My Sheep
john-21.label: John 21
john-21.question: We have walked through the whole Gospel of John. Jesus asked Peter, lovest thou me? How would you answer Jesus today, and how will you follow him?

jonah-00.title: Meet the Book of Jonah
jonah-00.label: Meet Jonah
jonah-00.question: Jonah ran from what God asked him to do. Have you ever wanted to run from something God was asking of you?

jonah-01.title: Jonah Rose Up to Flee
jonah-01.label: Jonah 1
jonah-01.question: The sailors came to fear the LORD, even while Jonah was running away from him. How has God used you, or someone else, even at a time when you were not following him well?

jonah-02.title: Salvation Is of the LORD
jonah-02.label: Jonah 2
jonah-02.question: Jonah remembered the LORD when his soul fainted within him. What has helped you turn back to God when you were at your lowest?

jonah-03.title: The People of Nineveh Believed God
jonah-03.label: Jonah 3
jonah-03.question: God came to Jonah the second time, and he spared Nineveh when they turned to him. Where in your life do you need God’s second chance today?

jonah-04.title: A Gracious God, and Merciful
jonah-04.label: Jonah 4
jonah-04.question: The book of Jonah ends with God’s question: should not I spare Nineveh? How would you answer God, if he asked you that question about the people you find hardest to love?

joshua-00.title: Meet the Book of Joshua
joshua-00.label: Meet Joshua
joshua-00.question: God told Joshua again and again to be strong and of a good courage. What is something in your life right now that needs courage?

joshua-01.title: Be Strong and of a Good Courage
joshua-01.label: Joshua 1
joshua-01.question: God told Joshua that his courage would come from God’s presence, and from God’s word. Which of those two do you most need to hold on to today, and why?

joshua-02.title: The LORD Your God, He Is God
joshua-02.label: Joshua 2
joshua-02.question: Rahab said, I know that the LORD hath given you the land, before she had seen it happen. What promise of God do you need to believe today, before you see it come true?

joshua-03.title: They Passed Over on Dry Ground
joshua-03.label: Joshua 3
joshua-03.question: The priests had to step into the flooding river before the water stopped. Have you ever had to take a step of faith before you could see the way ahead? What happened?

joshua-04.title: What Mean These Stones?
joshua-04.label: Joshua 4
joshua-04.question: Israel set up stones so their children would ask, what mean these stones? What is one story of God’s faithfulness that you would want the next generation to hear?

joshua-05.title: As Captain of the Host of the LORD
joshua-05.label: Joshua 5
joshua-05.question: Joshua asked, are you for us, or for our adversaries, and the answer was, nay. Why do you think it matters more that we are on God’s side, than that God is on ours?

joshua-06.title: Shout; for the LORD Hath Given You the City
joshua-06.label: Joshua 6
joshua-06.question: Israel walked round Jericho for seven days before anything happened. What helps you to keep trusting and obeying God when you cannot yet see any change?

joshua-07.title: I Coveted Them, and Took Them
joshua-07.label: Joshua 7
joshua-07.question: Achan saw, coveted, took, and hid. At which of those steps do you think it is easiest to stop sin, and how can you do that?

joshua-08.title: Fear Not, Neither Be Thou Dismayed
joshua-08.label: Joshua 8
joshua-08.question: Joshua read every word of the law, the blessings and the warnings. Why do you think it matters to hear the whole of God’s word, and not just the parts we like?

joshua-09.title: And Asked Not Counsel of the LORD
joshua-09.label: Joshua 9
joshua-09.question: Israel’s leaders looked at the evidence, but asked not counsel at the mouth of the LORD. What are some ways you can ask God for guidance before you make decisions?

joshua-10.title: Sun, Stand Thou Still
joshua-10.label: Joshua 10
joshua-10.question: Joshua kept his promise to Gibeon, even though they had tricked him. What does it look like to stand by someone we have made a promise to, even when it is costly?

joshua-11.title: And the Land Rested from War
joshua-11.label: Joshua 11
joshua-11.question: God told Joshua to destroy the chariots, so Israel would not trust in them. What things are you most tempted to rely on instead of God, and how can you turn your trust back to him?

joshua-12.title: All the Kings Thirty and One
joshua-12.label: Joshua 12
joshua-12.question: The writer counted the kings one by one, each one a sign of God’s faithfulness. If you made a list of God’s faithfulness in your own life, what would be the first three things on it?

joshua-13.title: The LORD God of Israel Was Their Inheritance
joshua-13.label: Joshua 13
joshua-13.question: God told Joshua, thou art old, and there remaineth yet very much land to be possessed. What do you think God might still want to do in your life, whatever your age or stage?

joshua-14.title: Give Me This Mountain
joshua-14.label: Joshua 14
joshua-14.question: Caleb asked for the very mountain that had frightened everyone else. What is a mountain in your life, something that seems too big, that you could ask God to help you face?

joshua-15.title: Give Me Also Springs of Water
joshua-15.label: Joshua 15
joshua-15.question: Achsah asked her father for springs of water, and he gave her more than she asked. What is something you need to ask your heavenly Father for boldly?

joshua-16.title: The Lot of the Children of Joseph
joshua-16.label: Joshua 16
joshua-16.question: God kept his promise to Joseph, long after Joseph had died. How does it encourage you to know that God’s faithfulness reaches beyond one lifetime?

joshua-17.title: The Mountain Shall Be Thine
joshua-17.label: Joshua 17
joshua-17.question: Joshua told the children of Joseph, if you are a great people, go and clear the forest. Is there a forest in your life that God might be asking you to clear?

joshua-18.title: How Long Are Ye Slack?
joshua-18.label: Joshua 18
joshua-18.question: Joshua asked, how long are ye slack to go to possess the land? Why do you think people sometimes hold back from what God has given them, and what helps us move forward?

joshua-19.title: According to the Word of the LORD
joshua-19.label: Joshua 19
joshua-19.question: Joshua made sure everyone else had their land before he took his own. What would it look like for you to put others first, in your home, your work or your church?

joshua-20.title: Appoint Out for You Cities of Refuge
joshua-20.label: Joshua 20
joshua-20.question: God made sure that no one in Israel was ever too far from a city of refuge. What does it mean to you that God is your refuge, a very present help in trouble?

joshua-21.title: There Failed Not Ought of Any Good Thing
joshua-21.label: Joshua 21
joshua-21.question: The writer said that not one of God’s good promises had failed. Which promise of God do you most need to hold on to right now?

joshua-22.title: It Shall Be a Witness Between Us
joshua-22.label: Joshua 22
joshua-22.question: Israel nearly went to war over a misunderstanding, but they talked first. Why do you think it is so important to listen before we judge?

joshua-23.title: Not One Thing Hath Failed
joshua-23.label: Joshua 23
joshua-23.question: At the end of his life, Joshua could say, not one thing hath failed. What would you want to be able to say about God at the end of your life?

joshua-24.title: As for Me and My House
joshua-24.label: Joshua 24
joshua-24.question: Joshua chose to serve the LORD, no matter what anyone else decided. What does it mean for you to say, as for me and my house, we will serve the LORD?

judges-00.title: Meet the Book of Judges
judges-00.label: Meet Judges
judges-00.question: The people of Israel forgot God within one generation. What helps you to remember what God has done, so that you do not drift away from him?

judges-01.title: Neither Did They Drive Them Out
judges-01.label: Judges 1
judges-01.question: Israel settled for less than God had promised, because it seemed easier. Where are you tempted to settle for half obedience, instead of following God fully?

judges-02.title: Nevertheless the LORD Raised Up Judges
judges-02.label: Judges 2
judges-02.question: A whole generation grew up who knew not the LORD. What do you think it takes for faith to be passed on from one generation to the next?

judges-03.title: The LORD Raised Up a Deliverer
judges-03.label: Judges 3
judges-03.question: God used Othniel from a family of faith, Ehud who was left-handed, and Shamgar with a farmer’s stick. What ordinary thing in your life might God want to use for his purposes?

judges-04.title: Is Not the LORD Gone Out Before Thee?
judges-04.label: Judges 4
judges-04.question: Barak would only go if Deborah went with him. Is it wrong to want others with us when God calls us, or can it be a good thing? What do you think?

judges-05.title: The Stars in Their Courses Fought
judges-05.label: Judges 5
judges-05.question: Some tribes came to help, and some stayed at home with great searchings of heart. What helps you to move from thinking about doing good, to actually doing it?

judges-06.title: The LORD Is with Thee, Thou Mighty Man of Valour
judges-06.label: Judges 6
judges-06.question: God called Gideon a mighty man of valour while he was hiding in a winepress. What do you think God might see in you that you cannot yet see in yourself?

judges-07.title: The Sword of the LORD, and of Gideon
judges-07.label: Judges 7
judges-07.question: God made Gideon’s army smaller so Israel could not boast. Why do you think God sometimes allows us to feel weak or small?

judges-08.title: The LORD Shall Rule over You
judges-08.label: Judges 8
judges-08.question: Gideon refused to be king, but then made the golden ephod that became a snare. Why do you think people are often most in danger right after a great success?

judges-09.title: The Trees Went Forth to Anoint a King
judges-09.label: Judges 9
judges-09.question: The olive tree, the fig tree and the vine all said no to ruling, because they were busy being fruitful. What fruitful work has God given you to do right where you are?

judges-10.title: His Soul Was Grieved for the Misery of Israel
judges-10.label: Judges 10
judges-10.question: When the people put away their strange gods, the Bible says God’s soul was grieved for their misery. What does this tell you about God’s heart toward people who turn back to him?

judges-11.title: I Have Opened My Mouth unto the LORD
judges-11.label: Judges 11
judges-11.question: Jephthah tried to bargain with God, when God had already given him his Spirit. Why do you think people try to make deals with God, and what does it show about how we see him?

judges-12.title: Say Now Shibboleth
judges-12.label: Judges 12
judges-12.question: The quarrel between Gilead and Ephraim began with pride and insults. What helps you to stop a disagreement from growing into a bigger fight?

judges-13.title: Why Askest Thou After My Name?
judges-13.label: Judges 13
judges-13.question: Manoah was afraid, but his wife reasoned from God’s kindness to them. When you are afraid, how can remembering what God has already done help you to trust him?

judges-14.title: Out of the Strong Came Forth Sweetness
judges-14.label: Judges 14
judges-14.question: Samson had great strength, but little self control. Which do you think is harder to have, and why does the Bible value self control so highly?

judges-15.title: The Cords Became as Flax Burnt with Fire
judges-15.label: Judges 15
judges-15.question: The men of Judah would rather tie up their deliverer than stand up to the Philistines. Why do you think people sometimes prefer a comfortable slavery to the risk of freedom?

judges-16.title: He Wist Not That the LORD Was Departed
judges-16.label: Judges 16
judges-16.question: Samson did not know that the LORD had departed from him. What helps you to notice when you are drifting away from God, before it is too late?

judges-17.title: Every Man Did That Which Was Right in His Own Eyes
judges-17.label: Judges 17
judges-17.question: Micah used the LORD’s name, but did what was right in his own eyes. How can we tell the difference between truly following God, and making a faith that suits ourselves?

judges-18.title: Ye Have Taken Away My Gods Which I Made
judges-18.label: Judges 18
judges-18.question: Micah cried, ye have taken away my gods which I made, and what have I more? What are some things people today depend on, that could be taken away from them?

judges-19.title: Consider of It, Take Advice, and Speak Your Minds
judges-19.label: Judges 19
judges-19.question: In this dark chapter, the only kindness came from an old man who was a stranger himself. What does it mean for you to be a light when the people around you are cold?

judges-20.title: Shall I Go Up Against Benjamin My Brother?
judges-20.label: Judges 20
judges-20.question: Benjamin chose loyalty to its own people over doing what was right. Why is it sometimes so hard to admit that someone on our side has done wrong?

judges-21.title: In Those Days There Was No King in Israel
judges-21.label: Judges 21
judges-21.question: The book of Judges ends, every man did that which was right in his own eyes. What do you think it looks like in our world today when people do what is right in their own eyes? And what would it look like to let God be King instead?

luke-00.title: Meet the Book of Luke
luke-00.label: Meet Luke
luke-00.question: Luke wrote so that his friend would know the certainty of what he had been taught. What would you like to be more certain of about Jesus by the end of this book?

luke-01.title: With God Nothing Shall Be Impossible
luke-01.label: Luke 1
luke-01.question: Mary said, be it unto me according to thy word. What part of your life will you put into God’s hands today?

luke-02.title: Good Tidings of Great Joy
luke-02.label: Luke 2
luke-02.question: Simeon held Jesus and said, mine eyes have seen thy salvation. How have you seen God’s salvation in your own life?

luke-03.title: All Flesh Shall See the Salvation of God
luke-03.label: Luke 3
luke-03.question: The crowds asked John, what shall we do then? What is one practical way you will show today that you belong to God?

luke-04.title: The Spirit of the Lord Is upon Me
luke-04.label: Luke 4
luke-04.question: Jesus said the Spirit of the Lord was upon him to heal the brokenhearted and set the captives free. Where do you need his freedom or healing today?

luke-05.title: Launch Out into the Deep
luke-05.label: Luke 5
luke-05.question: Peter said, nevertheless at thy word I will let down the net. What has Jesus asked of you that you will do today, even if you do not see how it will work?

luke-06.title: Be Ye Therefore Merciful
luke-06.label: Luke 6
luke-06.question: Jesus said, be ye therefore merciful, as your Father also is merciful. Who will you show mercy to today?

luke-07.title: She Loved Much
luke-07.label: Luke 7
luke-07.question: Jesus said, to whom little is forgiven, the same loveth little. How will you show Jesus your love today, remembering how much he has forgiven you?

luke-08.title: Where Is Your Faith?
luke-08.label: Luke 8
luke-08.question: Jesus asked his frightened disciples, where is your faith? Where will you put your trust today, in the storm you are facing?

luke-09.title: He Stedfastly Set His Face
luke-09.label: Luke 9
luke-09.question: Jesus said, take up his cross daily, and follow me. What will it mean for you to follow Jesus today, in one specific way?

luke-10.title: Go, and Do Thou Likewise
luke-10.label: Luke 10
luke-10.question: Jesus said, go, and do thou likewise. Who is the person in need on your road today, and what will you do for them?

luke-11.title: Lord, Teach Us to Pray
luke-11.label: Luke 11
luke-11.question: Jesus said, ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find. What will you ask your Father for today, and keep asking?

luke-12.title: Fear Not, Little Flock
luke-12.label: Luke 12
luke-12.question: Jesus said, where your treasure is, there will your heart be also. What is one way you will be rich toward God today?

luke-13.title: Woman, Thou Art Loosed
luke-13.label: Luke 13
luke-13.question: Jesus longed to gather Jerusalem under his wings, but they would not. What will you bring to Jesus today, to shelter under his care?

luke-14.title: Compel Them to Come In
luke-14.label: Luke 14
luke-14.question: Jesus said, he that humbleth himself shall be exalted. Where will you take the lower place today, for someone else’s sake?

luke-15.title: He Was Lost, and Is Found
luke-15.label: Luke 15
luke-15.question: The younger son said, I will arise and go to my father. Is there something you need to bring home to your Father today?

luke-16.title: Ye Cannot Serve God and Mammon
luke-16.label: Luke 16
luke-16.question: Jesus said, ye cannot serve God and mammon. What is one way you will show today that God, not money, is your master?

luke-17.title: Where Are the Nine?
luke-17.label: Luke 17
luke-17.question: Jesus asked, were there not ten cleansed? but where are the nine? What will you turn back and thank God for today?

luke-18.title: God Be Merciful to Me a Sinner
luke-18.label: Luke 18
luke-18.question: The tax collector prayed, God be merciful to me a sinner. What do you need God’s mercy for today?

luke-19.title: To Seek and to Save That Which Was Lost
luke-19.label: Luke 19
luke-19.question: Jesus said, the Son of man is come to seek and to save that which was lost. How has Jesus found you, and who do you know who still needs to be found?

luke-20.title: Not a God of the Dead, but of the Living
luke-20.label: Luke 20
luke-20.question: Jesus said, render unto God the things which be God’s. What part of yourself will you give back to God today?

luke-21.title: Lift Up Your Heads
luke-21.label: Luke 21
luke-21.question: Jesus said, look up, and lift up your heads; for your redemption draweth nigh. What fear will you bring to him today, and trade for hope?

luke-22.title: Not My Will, but Thine, Be Done
luke-22.label: Luke 22
luke-22.question: Jesus prayed, not my will, but thine, be done. Where in your life will you pray that prayer today?

luke-23.title: Father, Forgive Them
luke-23.label: Luke 23
luke-23.question: The criminal said, Lord, remember me, and Jesus promised him paradise. What will you say to Jesus today, as you stand at his cross?

luke-24.title: The Lord Is Risen Indeed
luke-24.label: Luke 24
luke-24.question: Now that you have walked through the whole book of Luke, what has Jesus shown you about himself, and who will you tell?

mark-00.title: Meet the Book of Mark
mark-00.label: Meet Mark
mark-00.question: If someone asked you right now who Jesus is, what would you say? Hold on to your answer, and see how it grows over these sixteen chapters.

mark-01.title: Prepare Ye the Way
mark-01.label: Mark 1
mark-01.question: Simon and Andrew left their nets straightway. What is one thing you will lay down today to follow Jesus?

mark-02.title: Thy Sins Be Forgiven Thee
mark-02.label: Mark 2
mark-02.question: The four friends would not give up until they brought their friend to Jesus. Who is one person you will carry to Jesus in prayer today?

mark-03.title: Whosoever Shall Do the Will of God
mark-03.label: Mark 3
mark-03.question: Jesus chose the twelve first of all to be with him. When will you take time today simply to be with Jesus?

mark-04.title: Peace, Be Still
mark-04.label: Mark 4
mark-04.question: Which worry is choking God’s Word in your heart, and what will you do to pull it out today?

mark-05.title: Be Not Afraid, Only Believe
mark-05.label: Mark 5
mark-05.question: Jesus told the man to go home and tell how great things the Lord had done for him. Who will you tell today about something God has done for you?

mark-06.title: Be of Good Cheer: It Is I
mark-06.label: Mark 6
mark-06.question: Jesus said to his tired friends, come apart and rest a while. Where will you find a quiet moment with him today?

mark-07.title: He Hath Done All Things Well
mark-07.label: Mark 7
mark-07.question: Jesus said that evil comes from within, out of the heart. What is one thing in your heart that you will bring to God and ask him to make clean today?

mark-08.title: Whom Say Ye That I Am?
mark-08.label: Mark 8
mark-08.question: Jesus asked, but whom say ye that I am? What is your own answer today, in your own words?

mark-09.title: Lord, I Believe; Help Thou Mine Unbelief
mark-09.label: Mark 9
mark-09.question: The father prayed, Lord, I believe; help thou mine unbelief. What is one thing you find hard to trust God with, that you will bring to him in that same prayer today?

mark-10.title: To Give His Life a Ransom for Many
mark-10.label: Mark 10
mark-10.question: Jesus asked Bartimaeus, what wilt thou that I should do unto thee? If Jesus asked you that today, what would you say?

mark-11.title: Blessed Is He That Cometh
mark-11.label: Mark 11
mark-11.question: Jesus said, when ye stand praying, forgive. Is there someone you will choose to forgive today?

mark-12.title: Thou Shalt Love the Lord Thy God
mark-12.label: Mark 12
mark-12.question: Jesus said, love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, soul, mind and strength. Which part of your life will you give to God more fully today?

mark-13.title: Take Ye Heed, Watch and Pray
mark-13.label: Mark 13
mark-13.question: Jesus said, take heed, watch and pray. What is one thing you will do today to stay awake and ready for him?

mark-14.title: Not What I Will, but What Thou Wilt
mark-14.label: Mark 14
mark-14.question: Jesus prayed, not what I will, but what thou wilt. Where in your life will you pray that same prayer today?

mark-15.title: Truly This Man Was the Son of God
mark-15.label: Mark 15
mark-15.question: Barabbas went free because Jesus took his place. What will you say to Jesus today, knowing that he took your place?

mark-16.title: He Is Risen; He Is Not Here
mark-16.label: Mark 16
mark-16.question: Now that you have walked through the whole book of Mark, who do you say Jesus is, and who will you tell about him?

matthew-00.title: Meet the Book of Matthew
matthew-00.label: Meet Matthew
matthew-00.question: Jesus called Matthew, a man many people despised, to follow him. Who might God be calling that others would overlook, and could that person be you?

matthew-01.title: They Shall Call His Name Emmanuel
matthew-01.label: Matthew 1
matthew-01.question: Matthew’s family line includes outsiders and people with painful stories. What does that tell you about who is welcome in God’s family?

matthew-02.title: We Have Seen His Star
matthew-02.label: Matthew 2
matthew-02.question: The wise men gave Jesus gold, frankincense and myrrh. What could you give to Jesus, that would show he is your King?

matthew-03.title: This Is My Beloved Son
matthew-03.label: Matthew 3
matthew-03.question: John said that real repentance shows in our lives, like fruit on a tree. What fruit would you like to see growing in your life?

matthew-04.title: Follow Me, and I Will Make You Fishers of Men
matthew-04.label: Matthew 4
matthew-04.question: The fishermen left their nets to follow Jesus. What might Jesus be asking you to leave behind, so you can follow him more closely?

matthew-05.title: Blessed Are the Pure in Heart
matthew-05.label: Matthew 5
matthew-05.question: Jesus said, love your enemies, and pray for those who treat you badly. Who is one person you find hard to love, that you could pray for this week?

matthew-06.title: Our Father Which Art in Heaven
matthew-06.label: Matthew 6
matthew-06.question: Jesus said, where your treasure is, there will your heart be also. What do you treasure most, and does it pull your heart towards God or away from him?

matthew-07.title: Ask, and It Shall Be Given You
matthew-07.label: Matthew 7
matthew-07.question: Jesus said the wise builder hears his words and does them. What is one thing Jesus said in the Sermon on the Mount that you want to start doing?

matthew-08.title: Speak the Word Only
matthew-08.label: Matthew 8
matthew-08.question: The disciples asked, what manner of man is this? From what you have heard so far in Matthew, how would you answer their question?

matthew-09.title: The Harvest Truly Is Plenteous
matthew-09.label: Matthew 9
matthew-09.question: Matthew left his tax booth and threw a dinner so his friends could meet Jesus. Who in your life would you like to introduce to Jesus?

matthew-10.title: Freely Ye Have Received, Freely Give
matthew-10.label: Matthew 10
matthew-10.question: Jesus said, freely ye have received, freely give. What is something God has given you that you could share with someone else?

matthew-11.title: Come unto Me, All Ye That Labour
matthew-11.label: Matthew 11
matthew-11.question: Jesus said, come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden. What is one heavy thing you could bring to him today?

matthew-12.title: A Bruised Reed Shall He Not Break
matthew-12.label: Matthew 12
matthew-12.question: Jesus said, out of the abundance of the heart the mouth speaketh. What do your words this week show about what is in your heart?

matthew-13.title: Treasure Hid in a Field
matthew-13.label: Matthew 13
matthew-13.question: The man sold everything for joy, to buy the field with the treasure. What makes Jesus worth more than anything else to you?

matthew-14.title: Lord, Save Me
matthew-14.label: Matthew 14
matthew-14.question: Peter began to sink when he looked at the wind instead of Jesus. What are the winds and waves that make you afraid, and how can you keep your eyes on Jesus?

matthew-15.title: O Woman, Great Is Thy Faith
matthew-15.label: Matthew 15
matthew-15.question: The woman of Canaan kept asking, even when Jesus was silent at first. What helps you keep trusting God when an answer seems slow?

matthew-16.title: Thou Art the Christ, the Son of the Living God
matthew-16.label: Matthew 16
matthew-16.question: Jesus asked, what shall a man give in exchange for his soul? What things in the world are tempting to chase, even if they might cost you your walk with God?

matthew-17.title: Hear Ye Him
matthew-17.label: Matthew 17
matthew-17.question: After the shining glory faded, the disciples saw Jesus only. Why do you think it matters that Jesus is enough, even in ordinary days?

matthew-18.title: Except Ye Become as Little Children
matthew-18.label: Matthew 18
matthew-18.question: The servant was forgiven a huge debt, but would not forgive a small one. Why do you think it is sometimes hard to forgive, even when we have been forgiven so much?

matthew-19.title: Suffer Little Children
matthew-19.label: Matthew 19
matthew-19.question: The rich young man went away sad because he had great possessions. What do you think Jesus would ask you to let go of, to follow him more fully?

matthew-20.title: So the Last Shall Be First
matthew-20.label: Matthew 20
matthew-20.question: Jesus said, whoever wants to be great must be a servant. What is one way you could serve someone at home, at school or at work this week?

matthew-21.title: Hosanna to the Son of David
matthew-21.label: Matthew 21
matthew-21.question: The crowd shouted Hosanna, which means save us now. What would you like Jesus to save you from, or help you with, today?

matthew-22.title: Many Are Called, but Few Are Chosen
matthew-22.label: Matthew 22
matthew-22.question: Jesus said, give to God the things that are God’s. If you bear God’s image, what does it mean to give yourself to him?

matthew-23.title: As a Hen Gathereth Her Chickens
matthew-23.label: Matthew 23
matthew-23.question: Jesus said that justice, mercy and faith are the weightier matters. Which of these would you like God to grow in your life?

matthew-24.title: Heaven and Earth Shall Pass Away
matthew-24.label: Matthew 24
matthew-24.question: Jesus said, blessed is the servant his lord finds faithfully at work when he comes. What would you like Jesus to find you doing when he comes?

matthew-25.title: Well Done, Thou Good and Faithful Servant
matthew-25.label: Matthew 25
matthew-25.question: Jesus said that when we help the least of these, we help him. Who is someone in need near you that you could help this week?

matthew-26.title: Could Ye Not Watch with Me One Hour?
matthew-26.label: Matthew 26
matthew-26.question: Jesus asked, could ye not watch with me one hour? What helps you stay close to Jesus when you feel tired or weak?

matthew-27.title: He Saved Others; Himself He Cannot Save
matthew-27.label: Matthew 27
matthew-27.question: The mockers said, he saved others; himself he cannot save. Why do you think Jesus did not come down from the cross, though he could have?

matthew-28.title: Lo, I Am with You Alway
matthew-28.label: Matthew 28
matthew-28.question: Matthew begins with Emmanuel, God with us, and ends with Jesus saying, I am with you alway. How does it change your day to know that Jesus is with you?

nehemiah-00.title: Meet the Book of Nehemiah
nehemiah-00.label: Meet Nehemiah
nehemiah-00.question: Nehemiah heard about the broken walls of Jerusalem, and it broke his heart. What breaks your heart, and how might God want you to respond?

nehemiah-01.title: Let Thine Ear Now Be Attentive
nehemiah-01.label: Nehemiah 1
nehemiah-01.question: Nehemiah began his prayer with who God is, then confessed sin, then held on to God’s promise, and only then made his request. How could this pattern help your own prayers?

nehemiah-02.title: The Good Hand of My God upon Me
nehemiah-02.label: Nehemiah 2
nehemiah-02.question: Nehemiah prayed for months, and then sent up a quick prayer in a moment of need. How could quick prayers fit into your everyday life?

nehemiah-03.title: Every One over Against His House
nehemiah-03.label: Nehemiah 3
nehemiah-03.question: In Nehemiah’s list, everyone had a part to play. What part do you think God has given you to play among his people?

nehemiah-04.title: The People Had a Mind to Work
nehemiah-04.label: Nehemiah 4
nehemiah-04.question: Nehemiah’s people prayed, and set a guard. How can you both trust God, and act wisely, when you face trouble?

nehemiah-05.title: Because of the Fear of God
nehemiah-05.label: Nehemiah 5
nehemiah-05.question: Nehemiah gave up what he was entitled to, because of the fear of God. Is there anything you have a right to that you might give up, for the good of others?

nehemiah-06.title: I Am Doing a Great Work
nehemiah-06.label: Nehemiah 6
nehemiah-06.question: The enemies tried mockery, threats, lies and fear to stop Nehemiah. Which of those do you find hardest to stand against, and why?

nehemiah-07.title: He Feared God Above Many
nehemiah-07.label: Nehemiah 7
nehemiah-07.question: Nehemiah chose Hananiah because he was faithful, and feared God above many. What do you think it means to fear God above many, and how could you grow in that?

nehemiah-08.title: The Joy of the LORD Is Your Strength
nehemiah-08.label: Nehemiah 8
nehemiah-08.question: The people wept when they heard God’s law, and then rejoiced because they understood it. How has God’s Word both humbled you and given you joy?

nehemiah-09.title: Thou Art a God Ready to Pardon
nehemiah-09.label: Nehemiah 9
nehemiah-09.question: The prayer tells of Israel’s failures again and again, and each time says, but thou. Where in your own story can you see God’s faithfulness, even when you failed?

nehemiah-10.title: We Will Not Forsake the House of Our God
nehemiah-10.label: Nehemiah 10
nehemiah-10.question: The people’s promises were very practical: money, wood, harvests and time. What practical promise could you make to God, to show that he comes first?

nehemiah-11.title: Willingly Offered Themselves
nehemiah-11.label: Nehemiah 11
nehemiah-11.question: Some people willingly offered themselves to live in Jerusalem, even though it cost them. What might it look like for you to willingly offer yourself to God?

nehemiah-12.title: The Joy of Jerusalem Was Heard Even Afar Off
nehemiah-12.label: Nehemiah 12
nehemiah-12.question: The joy of Jerusalem was heard even afar off. How might your joy in God be noticed by the people around you?

nehemiah-13.title: Remember Me, O My God, for Good
nehemiah-13.label: Nehemiah 13
nehemiah-13.question: The people broke their covenant within a few years. Why do you think it is so hard to keep our promises to God, and what can help us?

numbers-00.title: Meet the Book of Numbers
numbers-00.label: Meet Numbers
numbers-00.question: The people of Israel followed the cloud wherever it led. What would it look like for you to follow God step by step, even when you cannot see far ahead?

numbers-01.title: Every One Head of the House of His Fathers
numbers-01.label: Numbers 1
numbers-01.question: God counted his people one by one, with the number of their names. What difference does it make to you that God knows you personally, by name?

numbers-02.title: Every Man by His Own Standard
numbers-02.label: Numbers 2
numbers-02.question: Every tent in the camp faced the tabernacle, with God at the centre. What would it look like for God to be at the centre of your everyday life?

numbers-03.title: The Levites Shall Be Mine
numbers-03.label: Numbers 3
numbers-03.question: Every Levite family had a different job, curtains, boards, or holy things, but all of it was service to God. What job has God given you, and how can you do it as service to him?

numbers-04.title: Every One According to His Service
numbers-04.label: Numbers 4
numbers-04.question: Every Levite knew exactly what he was to carry, and no one had to carry everything. How does it help to know that you do not have to carry everything yourself?

numbers-05.title: Then They Shall Confess Their Sin
numbers-05.label: Numbers 5
numbers-05.question: God asked his people not only to confess, but to repay and add a fifth. Why do you think putting things right with people matters so much to God?

numbers-06.title: The LORD Bless Thee, and Keep Thee
numbers-06.label: Numbers 6
numbers-06.question: God himself gave the priests the words to bless his people. What does it tell you about God’s heart, that he wanted his people to hear this blessing again and again?

numbers-07.title: Each Prince on His Day
numbers-07.label: Numbers 7
numbers-07.question: Every leader brought the same gift, and every gift was written down in full. What does this tell you about how God sees what you give him?

numbers-08.title: The Seven Lamps Shall Give Light
numbers-08.label: Numbers 8
numbers-08.question: The older Levites stopped the heavy work, but still helped their brothers. How can people of every age serve God, even when their strength changes?

numbers-09.title: At the Commandment of the LORD They Journeyed
numbers-09.label: Numbers 9
numbers-09.question: Sometimes the cloud stayed a year, and sometimes it moved the next day. Which is harder for you: waiting for God, or moving when he says go?

numbers-10.title: Rise Up, LORD
numbers-10.label: Numbers 10
numbers-10.question: Moses prayed at the start and at the end of every journey. What difference would it make to begin and end each day with prayer?

numbers-11.title: Is the LORD’s Hand Waxed Short?
numbers-11.label: Numbers 11
numbers-11.question: The people grew tired of the manna God gave them every day. What gifts of God are you most likely to take for granted?

numbers-12.title: Heal Her Now, O God, I Beseech Thee
numbers-12.label: Numbers 12
numbers-12.question: Moses did not defend himself when Miriam and Aaron spoke against him, and then prayed for Miriam. What helps you to respond to criticism with meekness instead of anger?

numbers-13.title: We Are Well Able to Overcome It
numbers-13.label: Numbers 13
numbers-13.question: Ten spies saw giants, and Caleb saw the promise. When you face something hard, what helps you to see God as bigger than the problem?

numbers-14.title: My Servant Caleb Hath Followed Me Fully
numbers-14.label: Numbers 14
numbers-14.question: Caleb had another spirit, and followed God fully. What do you think it means to follow God fully, and not just halfway?

numbers-15.title: That Ye May Remember, and Do All My Commandments
numbers-15.label: Numbers 15
numbers-15.question: God gave his people a blue thread so they would remember his commandments. What everyday reminders help you to remember God?

numbers-16.title: He Stood Between the Dead and the Living
numbers-16.label: Numbers 16
numbers-16.question: Korah was not content with his calling, and wanted more. Why do you think discontent and jealousy are so dangerous?

numbers-17.title: The Rod of Aaron Was Budded
numbers-17.label: Numbers 17
numbers-17.question: God made a dead stick bud, blossom and bear fruit overnight. Where do you most need God to bring new life today?

numbers-18.title: I Am Thy Part and Thine Inheritance
numbers-18.label: Numbers 18
numbers-18.question: God told Aaron, I am thy part and thine inheritance. What would it mean for you to see God himself as your greatest treasure?

numbers-19.title: A Water of Separation, a Purification for Sin
numbers-19.label: Numbers 19
numbers-19.question: The ashes of the heifer were always kept ready, for anyone who needed cleansing. How does it encourage you that God’s cleansing is always available?

numbers-20.title: Speak Ye unto the Rock
numbers-20.label: Numbers 20
numbers-20.question: Moses struck the rock in anger instead of speaking to it, and it cost him dearly. Why do you think anger is so dangerous, especially for those who lead others?

numbers-21.title: When He Beheld the Serpent of Brass, He Lived
numbers-21.label: Numbers 21
numbers-21.question: The people were healed simply by looking at the bronze serpent in faith. What does it mean for you to look to Jesus, lifted up on the cross?

numbers-22.title: The LORD Opened the Eyes of Balaam
numbers-22.label: Numbers 22
numbers-22.question: Balaam said all the right words, but his heart was drawn to Balak’s reward. How can we tell when our hearts are not really following what our mouths say?

numbers-23.title: God Is Not a Man, That He Should Lie
numbers-23.label: Numbers 23
numbers-23.question: Balak kept moving to new places, hoping God would change his mind. Why is it such a comfort that God does not change, and does not go back on his word?

numbers-24.title: There Shall Come a Star out of Jacob
numbers-24.label: Numbers 24
numbers-24.question: God promised a Star out of Jacob, hundreds of years before Jesus was born. How does it strengthen your faith to see God’s promises fulfilled across so many years?

numbers-25.title: He Was Zealous for His God
numbers-25.label: Numbers 25
numbers-25.question: Balaam could not curse Israel, but Israel turned away from God from within. Why do you think the greatest dangers to our faith often come from inside, not outside?

numbers-26.title: Save Caleb the Son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the Son of Nun
numbers-26.label: Numbers 26
numbers-26.question: Only Caleb and Joshua were left from the first count. What do you think it was about them that made the difference?

numbers-27.title: As Sheep Which Have No Shepherd
numbers-27.label: Numbers 27
numbers-27.question: At the end of his life, Moses did not pray for himself, but for a shepherd for the people. What does this tell you about the kind of leader Moses was?

numbers-28.title: A Continual Burnt Offering
numbers-28.label: Numbers 28
numbers-28.question: The daily offering was never forgotten, even on the great feast days. Why do you think everyday faithfulness matters so much to God?

numbers-29.title: Ye Shall Keep a Feast unto the LORD
numbers-29.label: Numbers 29
numbers-29.question: In Israel’s seventh month, the day of sorrow for sin came before the feast of joy. Why do you think repentance and forgiveness open the way to real joy?

numbers-30.title: He Shall Not Break His Word
numbers-30.label: Numbers 30
numbers-30.question: Jesus said, let your yes be yes, and your no be no. What would it look like for your everyday words to be so trustworthy that you never needed to make special promises?

numbers-31.title: There Lacketh Not One Man of Us
numbers-31.label: Numbers 31
numbers-31.question: Balaam said beautiful words about God, but led Israel into sin. How can we be careful about whose advice and teaching we follow?

numbers-32.title: Be Sure Your Sin Will Find You Out
numbers-32.label: Numbers 32
numbers-32.question: Moses said, be sure your sin will find you out. Why do you think hidden sin so often catches up with us?

numbers-33.title: Moses Wrote Their Goings Out
numbers-33.label: Numbers 33
numbers-33.question: Moses wrote down every stop of the journey, the good and the bad. Looking back over your own life, where can you see God’s leading, even in the hard places?

numbers-34.title: This Shall Be Your Land
numbers-34.label: Numbers 34
numbers-34.question: God spoke of the land with certainty: when ye come. Which of God’s promises do you most need to hear spoken with that kind of certainty today?

numbers-35.title: For I the LORD Dwell Among the Children of Israel
numbers-35.label: Numbers 35
numbers-35.question: God provided cities of refuge so that no one was too far from safety. What does it mean to you that God is your refuge?

numbers-36.title: Even as the LORD Commanded Moses, So Did the Daughters of Zelophehad
numbers-36.label: Numbers 36
numbers-36.question: Numbers is full of grumbling and rebellion, but it ends with five sisters obeying God. What does this whole book teach you about God, and about following him?

philemon-00.title: Meet the Letter to Philemon
philemon-00.label: Meet Philemon
philemon-00.question: Onesimus had to go back and face the person he had wronged. Is there someone you need to make things right with?

philemon-01.title: Put That on Mine Account
philemon-01.label: Philemon 1
philemon-01.question: Paul said, put that on mine account. How does it make you feel to know that Jesus has taken your debt, and paid it for you?

philippians-00.title: Meet the Book of Philippians
philippians-00.label: Meet Philippians
philippians-00.question: Paul and Silas sang praises in prison, and Paul wrote a letter full of joy while he was in chains. What helps you to find joy in God when things are hard?

philippians-01.title: To Live Is Christ
philippians-01.label: Philippians 1
philippians-01.question: Paul said, for to me to live is Christ. If you finished that sentence honestly, for me to live is, what would you say? And what would you like to say?

philippians-02.title: Let This Mind Be in You
philippians-02.label: Philippians 2
philippians-02.question: Jesus humbled himself, and became a servant. Where in your life is it hardest for you to put others first, and what would it look like to have the mind of Christ there?

philippians-03.title: I Press Toward the Mark
philippians-03.label: Philippians 3
philippians-03.question: Paul said, this one thing I do: forgetting what is behind, I press toward the mark. What do you need to leave behind, and what will help you keep running toward Jesus?

philippians-04.title: The Peace of God
philippians-04.label: Philippians 4
philippians-04.question: Paul learned to be content in every situation, because Christ gave him strength. What is one worry you can turn into a prayer with thanksgiving today?

proverbs-00.title: Meet the Book of Proverbs
proverbs-00.label: Meet Proverbs
proverbs-00.question: Proverbs is full of advice from a father to his son. What is one piece of wise advice someone gave you, that you have never forgotten?

proverbs-01.title: The Fear of the LORD Is the Beginning of Knowledge
proverbs-01.label: Proverbs 1
proverbs-01.question: Proverbs says the fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge. What do you think it means to fear the LORD, and how could it make you wiser?

proverbs-02.title: As for Hid Treasures
proverbs-02.label: Proverbs 2
proverbs-02.question: Proverbs says to search for wisdom as for hidden treasure. What would it look like for you to seek God’s wisdom with that kind of eagerness?

proverbs-03.title: Her Ways Are Ways of Pleasantness
proverbs-03.label: Proverbs 3
proverbs-03.question: Proverbs says, withhold not good from them to whom it is due, when it is in thy power to do it. Who could you help this week, that you might have put off until later?

proverbs-04.title: Keep Thy Heart with All Diligence
proverbs-04.label: Proverbs 4
proverbs-04.question: Proverbs says, keep thy heart with all diligence, for out of it are the issues of life. What helps you to guard your heart, and what tends to pollute it?

proverbs-05.title: Rejoice with the Wife of Thy Youth
proverbs-05.label: Proverbs 5
proverbs-05.question: Proverbs says temptation is sweet at the start, but bitter at the end. Why do you think temptation never shows us the end, and how can we remember it?

proverbs-06.title: Go to the Ant, Thou Sluggard
proverbs-06.label: Proverbs 6
proverbs-06.question: The ant works hard without anyone telling her to. What helps you to work hard and do your best, even when no one is watching?

proverbs-07.title: Keep My Commandments, and Live
proverbs-07.label: Proverbs 7
proverbs-07.question: The young man’s trouble began when he walked down the street near her corner. What are the streets in your life that it would be wise to avoid?

proverbs-08.title: Doth Not Wisdom Cry?
proverbs-08.label: Proverbs 8
proverbs-08.question: Wisdom says she is better than rubies, and that nothing you desire can compare with her. If you really believed that, how might it change what you spend your time and energy on?

proverbs-09.title: Wisdom Hath Builded Her House
proverbs-09.label: Proverbs 9
proverbs-09.question: Wisdom and Folly both call out, whoso is simple, let him turn in hither. How can you tell the difference between them, when they sound so alike?

proverbs-10.title: A Wise Son Maketh a Glad Father
proverbs-10.label: Proverbs 10
proverbs-10.question: Proverbs says, in the multitude of words there wanteth not sin. When have you said something you later wished you had not said, and what did you learn from it?

proverbs-11.title: He That Watereth Shall Be Watered
proverbs-11.label: Proverbs 11
proverbs-11.question: Proverbs says, he that watereth shall be watered also himself. When have you been blessed by being generous to someone else?

proverbs-12.title: The Tongue of the Wise Is Health
proverbs-12.label: Proverbs 12
proverbs-12.question: Proverbs says a good word makes a heavy heart glad. Who has encouraged you with a good word, and who could you encourage today?

proverbs-13.title: He That Walketh with Wise Men
proverbs-13.label: Proverbs 13
proverbs-13.question: Proverbs says, he that walketh with wise men shall be wise. Who are the wise people in your life, and how could you spend more time learning from them?

proverbs-14.title: There Is a Way Which Seemeth Right
proverbs-14.label: Proverbs 14
proverbs-14.question: Proverbs says, there is a way which seemeth right unto a man, but the end thereof are the ways of death. How can you tell the difference between what seems right and what is truly right?

proverbs-15.title: A Soft Answer Turneth Away Wrath
proverbs-15.label: Proverbs 15
proverbs-15.question: Proverbs says, a soft answer turneth away wrath. When have you seen a gentle word calm an angry situation, and what makes it hard to answer gently?

proverbs-16.title: Commit Thy Works unto the LORD
proverbs-16.label: Proverbs 16
proverbs-16.question: Proverbs says, a man’s heart deviseth his way: but the LORD directeth his steps. When has God led you somewhere different from what you planned, and how did it turn out?

proverbs-17.title: A Friend Loveth at All Times
proverbs-17.label: Proverbs 17
proverbs-17.question: Proverbs says, a friend loveth at all times. Who has been that kind of friend to you, and for whom could you be that kind of friend?

proverbs-18.title: The Name of the LORD Is a Strong Tower
proverbs-18.label: Proverbs 18
proverbs-18.question: Proverbs says, death and life are in the power of the tongue. What kind of fruit have your words been producing lately?

proverbs-19.title: He That Hath Pity upon the Poor Lendeth unto the LORD
proverbs-19.label: Proverbs 19
proverbs-19.question: Proverbs says it is a glory to pass over a transgression. Why do you think forgiving can be harder than staying angry, and why does God call it glorious?

proverbs-20.title: The Spirit of Man Is the Candle of the LORD
proverbs-20.label: Proverbs 20
proverbs-20.question: Proverbs asks, who can say, I have made my heart clean? Why is it good news, not bad news, that we cannot make ourselves clean?

proverbs-21.title: The King’s Heart Is in the Hand of the LORD
proverbs-21.label: Proverbs 21
proverbs-21.question: Proverbs says, the horse is prepared against the day of battle, but safety is of the LORD. How can you prepare well for something, while still trusting God rather than your preparation?

proverbs-22.title: Train Up a Child in the Way He Should Go
proverbs-22.label: Proverbs 22
proverbs-22.question: Proverbs says a good name is rather to be chosen than great riches. What do you want to be known for, and what can you do today to build that kind of name?

proverbs-23.title: My Son, Give Me Thine Heart
proverbs-23.label: Proverbs 23
proverbs-23.question: The father says, my son, give me thine heart. What do you think it means to give God your heart, and what might be holding you back?

proverbs-24.title: A Just Man Falleth Seven Times
proverbs-24.label: Proverbs 24
proverbs-24.question: Proverbs says a just man falleth seven times, and riseth up again. What helps you to get back up when you have failed?

proverbs-25.title: A Word Fitly Spoken
proverbs-25.label: Proverbs 25
proverbs-25.question: Proverbs says, if thine enemy be hungry, give him bread. Why do you think kindness can be more powerful than revenge?

proverbs-26.title: Where No Wood Is, There the Fire Goeth Out
proverbs-26.label: Proverbs 26
proverbs-26.question: Proverbs says, where no wood is, there the fire goeth out. How could you help put out a quarrel or a rumour by refusing to add wood to the fire?

proverbs-27.title: Iron Sharpeneth Iron
proverbs-27.label: Proverbs 27
proverbs-27.question: Proverbs says, iron sharpeneth iron, so a man sharpeneth his friend. Who sharpens you, and whom could you help to sharpen?

proverbs-28.title: The Righteous Are Bold as a Lion
proverbs-28.label: Proverbs 28
proverbs-28.question: Proverbs says, the wicked flee when no man pursueth, but the righteous are bold as a lion. How does having a clear conscience before God change the way we live?

proverbs-29.title: Where There Is No Vision
proverbs-29.label: Proverbs 29
proverbs-29.question: Proverbs says, the fear of man bringeth a snare. When has worrying about what people think trapped you, and how can trusting God set you free?

proverbs-30.title: Every Word of God Is Pure
proverbs-30.label: Proverbs 30
proverbs-30.question: Agur prayed for neither poverty nor riches, but just enough. Why do you think too much and too little can both be dangerous for our faith?

proverbs-31.title: Who Can Find a Virtuous Woman?
proverbs-31.label: Proverbs 31
proverbs-31.question: Proverbs says, favour is deceitful, and beauty is vain, but a woman that feareth the LORD shall be praised. Why do you think the fear of the LORD matters more than charm or beauty?

psalms-000.title: Meet the Book of Psalms
psalms-000.label: Meet Psalms
psalms-000.question: The psalms bring every feeling to God, even the hard ones. Is there a feeling you find hard to bring to God, and what might the psalms teach you about that?

psalms-001.title: Like a Tree Planted by the Rivers of Water
psalms-001.label: Psalm 1
psalms-001.question: Psalm one says the blessed person is like a tree planted by the rivers of water. What helps your roots go deep into God, so that you stay strong in dry times?

psalms-002.title: Kiss the Son
psalms-002.label: Psalm 2
psalms-002.question: People in Psalm two see God’s rule as chains they want to break. Why do you think people want to be free from God, and what does real freedom look like?

psalms-008.title: How Excellent Is Thy Name
psalms-008.label: Psalm 8
psalms-008.question: David asks, what is man, that thou art mindful of him? How does it make you feel to know that the God who made the stars thinks about you?

psalms-013.title: How Long, O LORD?
psalms-013.label: Psalm 13
psalms-013.question: David begins by asking, how long wilt thou forget me? and ends by singing. What do you think helped him to change, even though his situation had not changed yet?

psalms-019.title: The Heavens Declare the Glory of God
psalms-019.label: Psalm 19
psalms-019.question: Psalm nineteen says God speaks through the heavens, and through his Word. Which of these helps you to know God more, and why?

psalms-022.title: My God, My God, Why Hast Thou Forsaken Me?
psalms-022.label: Psalm 22
psalms-022.question: Psalm twenty two was written long before Jesus was born, yet it describes his death in detail. What does that tell you about God’s plan, and about the Bible?

psalms-023.title: He Restoreth My Soul
psalms-023.label: Psalm 23
psalms-023.question: In the dark valley, David stops talking about God, and starts talking to him: for thou art with me. Why do you think hard times can bring us closer to God?

psalms-027.title: The LORD Is My Light and My Salvation
psalms-027.label: Psalm 27
psalms-027.question: David says his one great desire is to dwell in the house of the LORD, and behold his beauty. If you could ask God for only one thing, what would it be, and why?

psalms-032.title: Blessed Is He Whose Transgression Is Forgiven
psalms-032.label: Psalm 32
psalms-032.question: David says that when he kept silent about his sin, he felt heavy and dried up. Why do you think hiding our wrongs makes us feel so bad, and confessing them makes us feel free?

psalms-034.title: O Taste and See That the LORD Is Good
psalms-034.label: Psalm 34
psalms-034.question: David invites us to taste and see that the LORD is good. What do you think it means to taste God’s goodness for yourself, rather than just hearing about it?

psalms-037.title: Delight Thyself Also in the LORD
psalms-037.label: Psalm 37
psalms-037.question: David says, fret not thyself because of evildoers. Why do you think it is so easy to worry about unfair things, and what does David say we should do instead?

psalms-042.title: As the Hart Panteth After the Water Brooks
psalms-042.label: Psalm 42
psalms-042.question: The writer talks back to his feelings, saying, why art thou cast down, O my soul? hope thou in God. Why do you think it helps to tell ourselves what is true, instead of only listening to how we feel?

psalms-046.title: Be Still, and Know That I Am God
psalms-046.label: Psalm 46
psalms-046.question: The psalm says that even if the mountains fall into the sea, we will not fear. What is something that shakes you, and how could remembering that God is with you help?

psalms-051.title: Create in Me a Clean Heart
psalms-051.label: Psalm 51
psalms-051.question: David asks God not just to forgive him, but to create in him a clean heart. Why do you think we need a new heart, and not just forgiveness for what we have done?

psalms-062.title: He Only Is My Rock
psalms-062.label: Psalm 62
psalms-062.question: David says that, compared with God, even the most powerful people weigh less than a breath. What are some things people trust in instead of God, and why are they not strong enough to be our rock?

psalms-084.title: A Day in Thy Courts
psalms-084.label: Psalm 84
psalms-084.question: The writer says a day in God’s courts is better than a thousand anywhere else. What do you think makes being close to God so wonderful?

psalms-090.title: So Teach Us to Number Our Days
psalms-090.label: Psalm 90
psalms-090.question: Moses asks God to teach us to number our days, that we may apply our hearts unto wisdom. If you remembered every day that life is short, what might you do differently?

psalms-091.title: Under the Shadow of the Almighty
psalms-091.label: Psalm 91
psalms-091.question: God says, I will be with him in trouble, not, he will never have trouble. Why do you think that difference matters?

psalms-100.title: Enter into His Gates with Thanksgiving
psalms-100.label: Psalm 100
psalms-100.question: Psalm one hundred says, serve the LORD with gladness. What helps you to serve God gladly, instead of grudgingly?

psalms-103.title: Forget Not All His Benefits
psalms-103.label: Psalm 103
psalms-103.question: David tells his soul, forget not all his benefits. Why do you think it is so easy to forget God’s blessings, and what could help you remember them?

psalms-104.title: O LORD, How Manifold Are Thy Works
psalms-104.label: Psalm 104
psalms-104.question: Psalm one hundred and four says God made his creatures with wisdom, and that he still gives them life and food. What part of God’s creation fills you with the most wonder, and why?

psalms-107.title: Let the Redeemed of the LORD Say So
psalms-107.label: Psalm 107
psalms-107.question: In each of the four stories, the people cry out to the LORD in their trouble, and he rescues them. Why do you think we often wait until we are at our wits’ end before we cry out to God?

psalms-119.title: Thy Word Is a Lamp unto My Feet
psalms-119.label: Psalm 119
psalms-119.question: The writer says God’s Word is a lamp unto his feet. Can you think of a time when something from the Bible helped you to know what to do next?

psalms-121.title: My Help Cometh from the LORD
psalms-121.label: Psalm 121
psalms-121.question: The psalm says God neither slumbers nor sleeps. How does it help you to know that God is always awake, always watching over you?

psalms-127.title: Except the LORD Build the House
psalms-127.label: Psalm 127
psalms-127.question: The psalm says, except the LORD build the house, they labour in vain that build it. What do you think it looks like to let God be the builder of your life?

psalms-130.title: Out of the Depths
psalms-130.label: Psalm 130
psalms-130.question: The psalm asks, if God kept a record of every sin, who could stand? Why is it such good news that there is forgiveness with God?

psalms-133.title: How Good and How Pleasant
psalms-133.label: Psalm 133
psalms-133.question: The psalm says that where God’s people live in unity, there the LORD commands the blessing. Why do you think unity matters so much to God?

psalms-139.title: Fearfully and Wonderfully Made
psalms-139.label: Psalm 139
psalms-139.question: God knows everything about you, the good and the bad, and still loves you. How does that change the way you think about yourself?

psalms-145.title: Great Is the LORD, and Greatly to Be Praised
psalms-145.label: Psalm 145
psalms-145.question: David says the great King of the universe is near to all who call upon him in truth. What do you think it means to call upon God in truth?

psalms-150.title: Let Every Thing That Hath Breath Praise the LORD
psalms-150.label: Psalm 150
psalms-150.question: The book of Psalms is full of every feeling, sorrow, fear, guilt and joy, but it ends with pure praise. Why do you think the book ends this way, and what does that teach us about life with God?

ruth-00.title: Meet the Book of Ruth
ruth-00.label: Meet Ruth
ruth-00.question: Ruth is a story about faithful, loyal love in a hard and dark time. Who in your life has shown you that kind of love?

ruth-01.title: Whither Thou Goest, I Will Go
ruth-01.label: Ruth 1
ruth-01.question: Ruth said to Naomi, thy people shall be my people, and thy God my God. What has it cost you, or what might it cost you, to choose to follow God?

ruth-02.title: Under Whose Wings Thou Art Come to Trust
ruth-02.label: Ruth 2
ruth-02.question: It just so happened that Ruth came to the field of Boaz. Can you look back and see a time when something that seemed like chance was really God at work in your life?

ruth-03.title: Thou Art a Virtuous Woman
ruth-03.label: Ruth 3
ruth-03.question: Ruth asked Boaz to spread his protection over her, and he answered, fear not. What do you need to ask God for, trusting that he will answer you with the same care?

ruth-04.title: A Restorer of Thy Life
ruth-04.label: Ruth 4
ruth-04.question: Boaz redeemed Ruth and Naomi gladly, even though it cost him. What does it mean to you that Jesus has redeemed you, at great cost to himself?

walk-00.title: How to Walk Through a Chapter
walk-00.label: Start here
walk-00.question: As you begin this walk through the Bible, what do you hope to find?
